introduced inside, yielding one cost and one output region valid for every
ghost.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {states : Nat}

/-- The non-host component of the invariant, separated so it can be carried
across an update without mentioning the host tape. -/
def IdentPart (tapes' : Nat) (virt : Configuration (tapes' + 2) states)
    (base : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin (tapes' + 1), j.val < tapes' → base j = virt.tape ⟨j.val, by omega⟩

theorem identPart_update {tapes' : Nat} {virt : Configuration (tapes' + 2) states}
    {base : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape} (h : IdentPart tapes' virt base)
    (side : TrackSide) (X : Tape) (Y : Tape) :
    IdentPart tapes'
      { state := virt.state
        tape := Function.update virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side) X }
      (Function.update base (Fin.last tapes') Y) := by
  intro j hj
  have hne : j ≠ Fin.last tapes' := by
    intro hcon; rw [hcon] at hj; simp at hj
  have hne2 : (⟨j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (tapes' + 2)) ≠ hostIdx tapes' side := by
    intro hcon
    have := congrArg Fin.val hcon
    cases side <;> simp [hostIdx] at this <;> omega
  rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
  show base j = Function.update virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side) X _
  rw [Function.update_of_ne hne2]
  exact h j hj

/-- **The update, with cost and output region fixed before the ghost.** -/
theorem updateTrack_step_u {tapes' : Nat}
    (virt : Configuration (tapes' + 2) states)
    (base : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape) (blocks : List Block)
    (side : TrackSide) (s : TapeSymbol) (mv : HeadMove)
    (hident : IdentPart tapes' virt base)
    (hosts : HostsPair blocks (fun sd => virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' sd))) :
    ∃ (cost : Nat) (blocks' : List Block),
      cost ≤ 100 * blocks.length + 300 ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G →
        HaltsExactly (updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv)
          ((updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv).startCfg
            (Function.update base (Fin.last tapes')
              (ParkedTape blocks G))) cost false ∧
        ∃ G', AllBlank G' ∧
          (((updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv).step^[cost])
            ((updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv).startCfg
              (Function.update base (Fin.last tapes')
                (ParkedTape blocks G)))).tape =
            Function.update base (Fin.last tapes')
              (ParkedTape blocks' G') ∧
          MergeInv tapes'
            { state := virt.state
              tape := Function.update virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)
                (Tape.move
                  (Tape.write (virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)) s) mv) }
            (Function.update base (Fin.last tapes')
              (ParkedTape blocks' G')) blocks' G' := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨pre, cur, post, hsplit, -⟩ := hosts side
  have hblocks := hsplit.eq
  subst hblocks
  have hpk : ∀ (bl : List Block) (Gx : List TapeSymbol),
      (Function.update base (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape bl Gx))
        (Fin.last tapes') = ParkedTape bl Gx := by
    intro bl Gx; simp
  have hstart : ∀ (Gx : List TapeSymbol),
      (Function.update base (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape (pre ++ cur :: post) Gx))
        (Fin.last tapes') = ParkedTape (pre ++ cur :: post) Gx := fun Gx => hpk _ _
  cases mv with
  | stay =>
      obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_stay_bounded side
        (Fin.last tapes') s pre cur post hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
      refine ⟨cost, pre ++ setSymFlag side s true cur :: post, hbound, ?_⟩
      intro G hG
      obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G _ hG (hstart G)
      rw [Function.update_idem] at htape
      refine ⟨hhalt, G', hG', htape, identPart_update hident side _ _,
        hpk _ _, hG', ?_⟩
      have hp := hosts.update_stay side hsplit s
      simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
      exact hp
  | right =>
      cases post with
      | cons nxt post' =>
          obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_right_cons_bounded side
            (Fin.last tapes') s pre cur nxt post' hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
          refine ⟨cost, pre ++ setSymFlag side s false cur ::
            setFlag side true nxt :: post', hbound, ?_⟩
          intro G hG
          obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G _ hG (hstart G)
          rw [Function.update_idem] at htape
          refine ⟨hhalt, G', hG', htape, identPart_update hident side _ _,
            hpk _ _, hG', ?_⟩
          have hp := hosts.update_right_mid side hsplit s
          simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
          exact hp
      | nil =>
          obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_right_nil_bounded side
            (Fin.last tapes') s pre cur hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
          refine ⟨cost, pre ++ [setSymFlag side s false cur,
            freshFlagged side], hbound, ?_⟩
          intro G hG
          obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G _ hG (hstart G)
          rw [Function.update_idem] at htape
          refine ⟨hhalt, G', hG', htape, identPart_update hident side _ _,
            hpk _ _, hG', ?_⟩
          have hp := hosts.update_right_edge side hsplit s
          simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
          exact hp
  | left =>
      rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat pre with rfl | ⟨pre', prv, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_left_nil_bounded side
          (Fin.last tapes') s cur post hsplit.curSet
        refine ⟨cost, freshFlagged side ::
          setSymFlag side s false cur :: post, hbound, ?_⟩
        intro G hG
        obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G _ hG
          (by have h := hstart G; simp only [List.nil_append] at h; exact h)
        rw [Function.update_idem] at htape
        refine ⟨by simpa using hhalt, G', hG', by simpa using htape,
          identPart_update hident side _ _, hpk _ _, hG', ?_⟩
        have hp := hosts.update_left_edge side (by simpa using hsplit) s
        simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
        exact hp
      · simp only [List.concat_eq_append] at *
        obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_left_concat_bounded side
          (Fin.last tapes') s pre' prv cur post hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
        refine ⟨cost, pre' ++ setFlag side true prv ::
          setSymFlag side s false cur :: post, hbound, ?_⟩
        intro G hG
        obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G _ hG (hstart G)
        rw [Function.update_idem] at htape
        refine ⟨hhalt, G', hG', htape, identPart_update hident side _ _,
          hpk _ _, hG', ?_⟩
        have hp := hosts.update_left_mid side hsplit s
        simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
        exact hp

end SipserGacsLautemann

theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_bounded_specs

/-!
# Pieces of the per-step theorem

Module E3b of the merge_empty plan, first part: the small facts the per-step
theorem needs, isolated and proved before the large composition depends on
them.

The two with real content:

* `hostSyms_eq` — the symbol view the step program assembles equals the
  simulated machine's *true* view.  The identity-mapped tapes contribute
  their physical heads (they are literally the virtual tapes), and the two
  hosted tracks contribute the symbols the read phases learned, which
  `HostsPair.head_eq` identifies with the virtual heads.
* `MergeInv` — the full simulation invariant, and its head-symbol corollary.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

/-! ## Track sides as virtual indices -/

@[simp] theorem hostIdx_A_val (tapes' : Nat) :
    (hostIdx tapes' TrackSide.A).val = tapes' := rfl

@[simp] theorem hostIdx_B_val (tapes' : Nat) :
    (hostIdx tapes' TrackSide.B).val = tapes' + 1 := rfl

/-! ## The full invariant -/

/-- The simulation invariant: the identity-mapped physical tapes *are* the
corresponding virtual tapes, the host tape carries the other two as a parked
two-track region, and the control carries the simulated state. -/
structure MergeInv {states : Nat} (tapes' : Nat)
    (virt : Configuration (tapes' + 2) states)
    (phys : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape) (blocks : List Block)
    (G : List TapeSymbol) : Prop where
  ident : ∀ j : Fin (tapes' + 1), j.val < tapes' →
    phys j = virt.tape ⟨j.val, by omega⟩
  parked : phys (Fin.last tapes') = ParkedTape blocks G
  ghost : AllBlank G
  hosts : HostsPair blocks
    (fun side => virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side))

/-- The symbol view the step program assembles is the simulated machine's true
view.  Below `tapes'` the physical head *is* the virtual head; at the two
hosted indices the learned symbols are the virtual heads by `HostsPair`. -/
theorem hostSyms_eq {states : Nat} {tapes' : Nat}
    {virt : Configuration (tapes' + 2) states}
    {phys : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape} {blocks : List Block}
    {G : List TapeSymbol} (h : MergeInv tapes' virt phys blocks G)
    {preA : List Block} {curA : Block} {postA : List Block}
    (hA : SplitAtFlag TrackSide.A blocks preA curA postA)
    {preB : List Block} {curB : Block} {postB : List Block}
    (hB : SplitAtFlag TrackSide.B blocks preB curB postB) :
    hostSyms tapes' (fun j => (phys j).head)
        (TrackSide.A.pick curA) (TrackSide.B.pick curB) =
      fun k => (virt.tape k).head := by
  funext k
  rw [hostSyms]
  by_cases hk : k.val < tapes'
  · rw [dif_pos hk, h.ident ⟨k.val, by omega⟩ hk]
  · rw [dif_neg hk]
    by_cases hk2 : k.val = tapes'
    · rw [if_pos hk2, h.hosts.head_eq TrackSide.A hA]
      exact congrArg (fun t : Tape => t.head)
        (congrArg virt.tape (Fin.ext (by simp [hostIdx, hk2])))
    · rw [if_neg hk2, h.hosts.head_eq TrackSide.B hB]
      have hval : k.val = tapes' + 1 := by omega
      exact congrArg (fun t : Tape => t.head)
        (congrArg virt.tape (Fin.ext (by simp [hostIdx, hval])))

/-! ## The execute step's tape effect -/

/-- The execute action leaves the host tape alone. -/
theorem execAction_host {states : Nat} (tapes' : Nat)
    (M : Machine (tapes' + 2) states) (q : Fin states) (sA sB : TapeSymbol)
    (syms : Fin (tapes' + 1) → TapeSymbol) :
    execAction tapes' M q sA sB syms (Fin.last tapes') =
      (syms (Fin.last tapes'), HeadMove.stay) := by
  rw [execAction, dif_neg (by simp)]

/-- …so applying it preserves the host tape exactly. -/
theorem applyAction_execAction_host {states : Nat} (tapes' : Nat)
    (M : Machine (tapes' + 2) states) (q : Fin states) (sA sB : TapeSymbol)
    (tape : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape) :
    applyAction tape (execAction tapes' M q sA sB) (Fin.last tapes') =
      tape (Fin.last tapes') := by
  rw [applyAction, execAction_host]
  simp [Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

/-- On an identity-mapped tape the execute action applies the simulated
machine's own action. -/
theorem applyAction_execAction_ident {states : Nat} (tapes' : Nat)
    (M : Machine (tapes' + 2) states) (q : Fin states) (sA sB : TapeSymbol)
    (tape : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape) (j : Fin (tapes' + 1))
    (hj : j.val < tapes') :
    applyAction tape (execAction tapes' M q sA sB) j =
      Tape.move
        (Tape.write (tape j)
          ((M.transition q (hostSyms tapes' (fun l => (tape l).head) sA sB)).2
            ⟨j.val, by omega⟩).1)
        ((M.transition q (hostSyms tapes' (fun l => (tape l).head) sA sB)).2
          ⟨j.val, by omega⟩).2 := by
  rw [applyAction, execAction, dif_pos hj]

/-! ## The simulated step, unfolded -/

/-- While the simulated machine is live, its step applies its transition. -/
theorem Machine.step_of_result_none {n states : Nat}
    (M : Machine n states) (c : Configuration n states)
    (h : M.result c.state = none) :
    M.step c =
      { state := (M.transition c.state (fun i => (c.tape i).head)).1
        tape := fun i =>
          Tape.move
            (Tape.write (c.tape i)
              ((M.transition c.state (fun i => (c.tape i).head)).2 i).1)
            ((M.transition c.state (fun i => (c.tape i).head)).2 i).2 } := by
  unfold Machine.step
  rw [h]


theorem hostIdx_ne {tapes' : Nat} {side side' : TrackSide} (h : side' ≠ side) :
    hostIdx tapes' side' ≠ hostIdx tapes' side := by
  cases side <;> cases side' <;>
    first
      | exact absurd rfl h
      | (intro hcon; have := congrArg Fin.val hcon; simp [hostIdx] at this)

/-- Updating a virtual tape at a hosted index, viewed through the two tracks. -/
@[simp] theorem virtTape_update_apply (tapes' : Nat)
    (vt : Fin (tapes' + 2) → Tape) (side side' : TrackSide) (X : Tape) :
    Function.update vt (hostIdx tapes' side) X (hostIdx tapes' side') =
      Function.update (fun s' => vt (hostIdx tapes' s')) side X side' := by
  by_cases hss : side' = side
  · subst hss; simp
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hss, Function.update_of_ne (hostIdx_ne hss)]

/-! ## The single-track update, packaged

One theorem covering all three head-moves and both edges: given the invariant
and a write-and-move for one track, the update halts within an affine bound and
re-establishes the invariant with that track's virtual tape written and moved,
the other untouched.  The five bounded specifications and the five `HostsPair`
preservations are matched up here, once, so the per-step theorem sees a single
uniform fact. -/

theorem updateTrack_step {states : Nat} {tapes' : Nat}
    {virt : Configuration (tapes' + 2) states}
    {phys : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape} {blocks : List Block}
    {G : List TapeSymbol} (h : MergeInv tapes' virt phys blocks G)
    (side : TrackSide) (s : TapeSymbol) (mv : HeadMove) :
    ∃ (cost : Nat) (blocks' : List Block) (G' : List TapeSymbol),
      cost ≤ 100 * blocks.length + 300 ∧
      HaltsExactly (updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv)
        ((updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv).startCfg phys) cost false ∧
      (((updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv).step^[cost])
        ((updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv).startCfg phys)).tape =
        Function.update phys (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape blocks' G') ∧
      MergeInv tapes'
        { state := virt.state
          tape := Function.update virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)
            (Tape.move (Tape.write (virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)) s) mv) }
        (Function.update phys (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape blocks' G'))
        blocks' G' := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨pre, cur, post, hsplit, -⟩ := h.hosts side
  have hblocks := hsplit.eq
  subst hblocks
  -- the invariant's non-host components are untouched by every variant
  have hident : ∀ (bl : List Block) (Gx : List TapeSymbol),
      ∀ j : Fin (tapes' + 1), j.val < tapes' →
        (Function.update phys (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape bl Gx)) j =
          (Function.update virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)
            (Tape.move (Tape.write (virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)) s) mv))
            ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ := by
    intro bl Gx j hj
    have hne : j ≠ Fin.last tapes' := by
      intro hcon
      rw [hcon] at hj
      simp at hj
    have hne2 : (⟨j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (tapes' + 2)) ≠ hostIdx tapes' side := by
      intro hcon
      have := congrArg Fin.val hcon
      cases side <;> simp [hostIdx] at this <;> omega
    rw [Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_of_ne hne2]
    exact h.ident j hj
  have hpark : ∀ (bl : List Block) (Gx : List TapeSymbol),
      (Function.update phys (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape bl Gx))
        (Fin.last tapes') = ParkedTape bl Gx := by
    intro bl Gx; simp
  cases mv with
  | stay =>
      obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_stay_bounded side
        (Fin.last tapes') s pre cur post hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
      obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost h.parked
      refine ⟨cost, pre ++ setSymFlag side s true cur :: post, G', hbound,
        hhalt, htape, ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
      · exact hident _ _
      · have := h.hosts.update_stay side hsplit s
        simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
        exact this
  | right =>
      cases post with
      | cons nxt post' =>
          obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_right_cons_bounded side
            (Fin.last tapes') s pre cur nxt post' hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
          obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost h.parked
          refine ⟨cost, pre ++ setSymFlag side s false cur ::
            setFlag side true nxt :: post', G', hbound, hhalt, htape,
            ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
          · exact hident _ _
          · have := h.hosts.update_right_mid side hsplit s
            simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
            exact this
      | nil =>
          obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_right_nil_bounded side
            (Fin.last tapes') s pre cur hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
          obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost h.parked
          refine ⟨cost, pre ++ [setSymFlag side s false cur,
            freshFlagged side], G', hbound, hhalt, htape,
            ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
          · exact hident _ _
          · have := h.hosts.update_right_edge side hsplit s
            simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
            exact this
  | left =>
      rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat pre with rfl | ⟨pre', prv, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_left_nil_bounded side
          (Fin.last tapes') s cur post hsplit.curSet
        obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost
          (by simpa using h.parked)
        refine ⟨cost, freshFlagged side :: setSymFlag side s false cur :: post,
          G', hbound, ?_, ?_, ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
        · simpa using hhalt
        · simpa using htape
        · exact hident _ _
        · have := h.hosts.update_left_edge side (by simpa using hsplit) s
          simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
          exact this
      · simp only [List.concat_eq_append] at *
        obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_left_concat_bounded side
          (Fin.last tapes') s pre' prv cur post hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
        obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost h.parked
        refine ⟨cost, pre' ++ setFlag side true prv ::
          setSymFlag side s false cur :: post, G', hbound, hhalt, htape,
          ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
        · exact hident _ _
        · have := h.hosts.update_left_mid side hsplit s
          simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
          exact this

end SipserGacsLautemann

Pieces of the per-step theorem: the simulation invariant, the symbol-view identification, and the packaged track update.

**`MergeInv`** is the full simulation invariant. The physical tapes below the host index *are* the corresponding virtual tapes (identity-mapped, so the simulated machine's writes and moves apply to them directly); the host tape carries the remaining two virtual tapes as a parked two-track region with an all-blank ghost; and the two tracks satisfy `HostsPair`.

**`hostSyms_eq`** is the identification that makes the execute phase correct: the symbol view the step program assembles equals the simulated machine's *true* view $k \mapsto (\mathrm{virt.tape}\ k).\mathrm{head}$. Below the host index the physical head is the virtual head by identity-mapping; at the two hosted indices, the symbols the read phases learned are the virtual heads by `HostsPair.head_eq`. So the transition the program applies is the transition the simulated machine would take.

**`updateTrack_step`** packages all of module D's and the invariant layer's case analysis into one uniform fact. Given the invariant and a write-and-move for one track, the update halts within $100|{\rm blocks}| + 300$ steps, leaves the host tape parked on a new region, and re-establishes `MergeInv` with that track's virtual tape written and moved and the other untouched. Internally it selects among the five bounded specifications and pairs each with its matching `HostsPair` preservation — three head-moves, two of which split at the region's edges. theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_bounded_specs

/-!
# Pieces of the per-step theorem

Module E3b of the merge_empty plan, first part: the small facts the per-step
theorem needs, isolated and proved before the large composition depends on
them.

The two with real content:

* `hostSyms_eq` — the symbol view the step program assembles equals the
  simulated machine's *true* view.  The identity-mapped tapes contribute
  their physical heads (they are literally the virtual tapes), and the two
  hosted tracks contribute the symbols the read phases learned, which
  `HostsPair.head_eq` identifies with the virtual heads.
* `MergeInv` — the full simulation invariant, and its head-symbol corollary.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

/-! ## Track sides as virtual indices -/

@[simp] theorem hostIdx_A_val (tapes' : Nat) :
    (hostIdx tapes' TrackSide.A).val = tapes' := rfl

@[simp] theorem hostIdx_B_val (tapes' : Nat) :
    (hostIdx tapes' TrackSide.B).val = tapes' + 1 := rfl

/-! ## The full invariant -/

/-- The simulation invariant: the identity-mapped physical tapes *are* the
corresponding virtual tapes, the host tape carries the other two as a parked
two-track region, and the control carries the simulated state. -/
structure MergeInv {states : Nat} (tapes' : Nat)
    (virt : Configuration (tapes' + 2) states)
    (phys : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape) (blocks : List Block)
    (G : List TapeSymbol) : Prop where
  ident : ∀ j : Fin (tapes' + 1), j.val < tapes' →
    phys j = virt.tape ⟨j.val, by omega⟩
  parked : phys (Fin.last tapes') = ParkedTape blocks G
  ghost : AllBlank G
  hosts : HostsPair blocks
    (fun side => virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side))

/-- The symbol view the step program assembles is the simulated machine's true
view.  Below `tapes'` the physical head *is* the virtual head; at the two
hosted indices the learned symbols are the virtual heads by `HostsPair`. -/
theorem hostSyms_eq {states : Nat} {tapes' : Nat}
    {virt : Configuration (tapes' + 2) states}
    {phys : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape} {blocks : List Block}
    {G : List TapeSymbol} (h : MergeInv tapes' virt phys blocks G)
    {preA : List Block} {curA : Block} {postA : List Block}
    (hA : SplitAtFlag TrackSide.A blocks preA curA postA)
    {preB : List Block} {curB : Block} {postB : List Block}
    (hB : SplitAtFlag TrackSide.B blocks preB curB postB) :
    hostSyms tapes' (fun j => (phys j).head)
        (TrackSide.A.pick curA) (TrackSide.B.pick curB) =
      fun k => (virt.tape k).head := by
  funext k
  rw [hostSyms]
  by_cases hk : k.val < tapes'
  · rw [dif_pos hk, h.ident ⟨k.val, by omega⟩ hk]
  · rw [dif_neg hk]
    by_cases hk2 : k.val = tapes'
    · rw [if_pos hk2, h.hosts.head_eq TrackSide.A hA]
      exact congrArg (fun t : Tape => t.head)
        (congrArg virt.tape (Fin.ext (by simp [hostIdx, hk2])))
    · rw [if_neg hk2, h.hosts.head_eq TrackSide.B hB]
      have hval : k.val = tapes' + 1 := by omega
      exact congrArg (fun t : Tape => t.head)
        (congrArg virt.tape (Fin.ext (by simp [hostIdx, hval])))

/-! ## The execute step's tape effect -/

/-- The execute action leaves the host tape alone. -/
theorem execAction_host {states : Nat} (tapes' : Nat)
    (M : Machine (tapes' + 2) states) (q : Fin states) (sA sB : TapeSymbol)
    (syms : Fin (tapes' + 1) → TapeSymbol) :
    execAction tapes' M q sA sB syms (Fin.last tapes') =
      (syms (Fin.last tapes'), HeadMove.stay) := by
  rw [execAction, dif_neg (by simp)]

/-- …so applying it preserves the host tape exactly. -/
theorem applyAction_execAction_host {states : Nat} (tapes' : Nat)
    (M : Machine (tapes' + 2) states) (q : Fin states) (sA sB : TapeSymbol)
    (tape : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape) :
    applyAction tape (execAction tapes' M q sA sB) (Fin.last tapes') =
      tape (Fin.last tapes') := by
  rw [applyAction, execAction_host]
  simp [Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

/-- On an identity-mapped tape the execute action applies the simulated
machine's own action. -/
theorem applyAction_execAction_ident {states : Nat} (tapes' : Nat)
    (M : Machine (tapes' + 2) states) (q : Fin states) (sA sB : TapeSymbol)
    (tape : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape) (j : Fin (tapes' + 1))
    (hj : j.val < tapes') :
    applyAction tape (execAction tapes' M q sA sB) j =
      Tape.move
        (Tape.write (tape j)
          ((M.transition q (hostSyms tapes' (fun l => (tape l).head) sA sB)).2
            ⟨j.val, by omega⟩).1)
        ((M.transition q (hostSyms tapes' (fun l => (tape l).head) sA sB)).2
          ⟨j.val, by omega⟩).2 := by
  rw [applyAction, execAction, dif_pos hj]

/-! ## The simulated step, unfolded -/

/-- While the simulated machine is live, its step applies its transition. -/
theorem Machine.step_of_result_none {n states : Nat}
    (M : Machine n states) (c : Configuration n states)
    (h : M.result c.state = none) :
    M.step c =
      { state := (M.transition c.state (fun i => (c.tape i).head)).1
        tape := fun i =>
          Tape.move
            (Tape.write (c.tape i)
              ((M.transition c.state (fun i => (c.tape i).head)).2 i).1)
            ((M.transition c.state (fun i => (c.tape i).head)).2 i).2 } := by
  unfold Machine.step
  rw [h]


theorem hostIdx_ne {tapes' : Nat} {side side' : TrackSide} (h : side' ≠ side) :
    hostIdx tapes' side' ≠ hostIdx tapes' side := by
  cases side <;> cases side' <;>
    first
      | exact absurd rfl h
      | (intro hcon; have := congrArg Fin.val hcon; simp [hostIdx] at this)

/-- Updating a virtual tape at a hosted index, viewed through the two tracks. -/
@[simp] theorem virtTape_update_apply (tapes' : Nat)
    (vt : Fin (tapes' + 2) → Tape) (side side' : TrackSide) (X : Tape) :
    Function.update vt (hostIdx tapes' side) X (hostIdx tapes' side') =
      Function.update (fun s' => vt (hostIdx tapes' s')) side X side' := by
  by_cases hss : side' = side
  · subst hss; simp
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hss, Function.update_of_ne (hostIdx_ne hss)]

/-! ## The single-track update, packaged

One theorem covering all three head-moves and both edges: given the invariant
and a write-and-move for one track, the update halts within an affine bound and
re-establishes the invariant with that track's virtual tape written and moved,
the other untouched.  The five bounded specifications and the five `HostsPair`
preservations are matched up here, once, so the per-step theorem sees a single
uniform fact. -/

theorem updateTrack_step {states : Nat} {tapes' : Nat}
    {virt : Configuration (tapes' + 2) states}
    {phys : Fin (tapes' + 1) → Tape} {blocks : List Block}
    {G : List TapeSymbol} (h : MergeInv tapes' virt phys blocks G)
    (side : TrackSide) (s : TapeSymbol) (mv : HeadMove) :
    ∃ (cost : Nat) (blocks' : List Block) (G' : List TapeSymbol),
      cost ≤ 100 * blocks.length + 300 ∧
      HaltsExactly (updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv)
        ((updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv).startCfg phys) cost false ∧
      (((updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv).step^[cost])
        ((updateTrack side (Fin.last tapes') s mv).startCfg phys)).tape =
        Function.update phys (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape blocks' G') ∧
      MergeInv tapes'
        { state := virt.state
          tape := Function.update virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)
            (Tape.move (Tape.write (virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)) s) mv) }
        (Function.update phys (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape blocks' G'))
        blocks' G' := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨pre, cur, post, hsplit, -⟩ := h.hosts side
  have hblocks := hsplit.eq
  subst hblocks
  -- the invariant's non-host components are untouched by every variant
  have hident : ∀ (bl : List Block) (Gx : List TapeSymbol),
      ∀ j : Fin (tapes' + 1), j.val < tapes' →
        (Function.update phys (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape bl Gx)) j =
          (Function.update virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)
            (Tape.move (Tape.write (virt.tape (hostIdx tapes' side)) s) mv))
            ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ := by
    intro bl Gx j hj
    have hne : j ≠ Fin.last tapes' := by
      intro hcon
      rw [hcon] at hj
      simp at hj
    have hne2 : (⟨j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (tapes' + 2)) ≠ hostIdx tapes' side := by
      intro hcon
      have := congrArg Fin.val hcon
      cases side <;> simp [hostIdx] at this <;> omega
    rw [Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_of_ne hne2]
    exact h.ident j hj
  have hpark : ∀ (bl : List Block) (Gx : List TapeSymbol),
      (Function.update phys (Fin.last tapes') (ParkedTape bl Gx))
        (Fin.last tapes') = ParkedTape bl Gx := by
    intro bl Gx; simp
  cases mv with
  | stay =>
      obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_stay_bounded side
        (Fin.last tapes') s pre cur post hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
      obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost h.parked
      refine ⟨cost, pre ++ setSymFlag side s true cur :: post, G', hbound,
        hhalt, htape, ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
      · exact hident _ _
      · have := h.hosts.update_stay side hsplit s
        simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
        exact this
  | right =>
      cases post with
      | cons nxt post' =>
          obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_right_cons_bounded side
            (Fin.last tapes') s pre cur nxt post' hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
          obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost h.parked
          refine ⟨cost, pre ++ setSymFlag side s false cur ::
            setFlag side true nxt :: post', G', hbound, hhalt, htape,
            ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
          · exact hident _ _
          · have := h.hosts.update_right_mid side hsplit s
            simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
            exact this
      | nil =>
          obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_right_nil_bounded side
            (Fin.last tapes') s pre cur hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
          obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost h.parked
          refine ⟨cost, pre ++ [setSymFlag side s false cur,
            freshFlagged side], G', hbound, hhalt, htape,
            ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
          · exact hident _ _
          · have := h.hosts.update_right_edge side hsplit s
            simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
            exact this
  | left =>
      rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat pre with rfl | ⟨pre', prv, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_left_nil_bounded side
          (Fin.last tapes') s cur post hsplit.curSet
        obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost
          (by simpa using h.parked)
        refine ⟨cost, freshFlagged side :: setSymFlag side s false cur :: post,
          G', hbound, ?_, ?_, ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
        · simpa using hhalt
        · simpa using htape
        · exact hident _ _
        · have := h.hosts.update_left_edge side (by simpa using hsplit) s
          simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
          exact this
      · simp only [List.concat_eq_append] at *
        obtain ⟨cost, hbound, hrun⟩ := updateTrack_left_concat_bounded side
          (Fin.last tapes') s pre' prv cur post hsplit.preClear hsplit.curSet
        obtain ⟨G', hG', hhalt, htape⟩ := hrun G phys h.ghost h.parked
        refine ⟨cost, pre' ++ setFlag side true prv ::
          setSymFlag side s false cur :: post, G', hbound, hhalt, htape,
          ?_, hpark _ _, hG', ?_⟩
        · exact hident _ _
        · have := h.hosts.update_left_mid side hsplit s
          simp only [virtTape_update_apply]
          exact this

end SipserGacsLautemann

theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_step_program

/-!
# Bounded, ghost-uniform specifications

Module E3a of the merge_empty plan (`DESIGN_E3_F.md` §1.1).

The published update and read-phase specifications hide their costs behind an
existential, quantified *after* the ghost.  Two consumers break on that: the
final polynomial accounting cannot bound an opaque per-round cost, and a
nested phase's `hcont` needs one fixed cost **for every ghost**.  The costs
are in fact ghost-independent and affinely bounded — the statements just
failed to say so.

This module restates them in the corrected shape

```
∃ cost, cost ≤ ⟨affine in the region size⟩ ∧
  ∀ G tape, AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape … G → ⟨the original conclusion⟩
```

— cost first, bound alongside, ghost and tape inside.  The proofs are the
original chain constructions with the cost supplied up front; the edge cases
become separate theorems (`right_cons`/`right_nil`, `left_concat`/`left_nil`)
so each statement names its own result region.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-- `blockReadSteps` is twelve. -/
theorem blockReadSteps_eq : blockReadSteps = 12 := rfl

/-! ## The stay variant, bounded -/

theorem updateTrack_stay_bounded (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes)
    (s : TapeSymbol) (mid : List Block) (cur : Block) (post : List Block)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true) :
    ∃ cost, cost ≤ 100 * (mid ++ cur :: post).length + 300 ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape),
        AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G →
        ∃ G', AllBlank G' ∧
          HaltsExactly (updateTrack side i s HeadMove.stay)
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.stay).startCfg tape) cost false ∧
          (((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.stay).step^[cost])
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.stay).startCfg tape)).tape =
            Function.update tape i
              (ParkedTape (mid ++ setSymFlag side s true cur :: post) G') := by
  classical
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + ((loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length +
      blockReadSteps) + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 +
      ((((Block.toCells (setSymFlag side s true cur)).reverse ++
        (encodeBlocks mid).reverse).length) * 4 + 3)))))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [loopCost_const, blockReadSteps_eq]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_reverse,
      Block.toCells_length, encodeBlocks_length, List.length_cons]
    omega
  intro G tape hG hi
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  set newCur := setSymFlag side s true cur with hnewCur
  -- junction 1: enter
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  -- junction 2: walk
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur post hmid hcur hT1i
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hsplit : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) =
      encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ encodeBlocks post := by
    rw [← encodeBlocks_append]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i, hsplit, List.append_assoc,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp,
      cellsTape_advance]
  -- junction 3: back onto the flagged block
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃))) with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
      show (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] =
          (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append]
        simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons],
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  -- junction 4: rewrite the flagged block
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s true)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s true)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T3 _ _ hT3i, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_symWindow, ← hnewCur,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  -- junction 5: retreat again
  obtain ⟨G₅, hG₅, hret5⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells newCur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G₃ hG₃
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT5
  have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4, hT5]
    congr 1
    rw [hT4i,
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse).length by
        simp [Block.toCells_length]]
    rw [hret5, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT5]; simp
  -- junction 6: identity window
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) with hT6
  have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i allNormWindow).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i allNormWindow).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T5 _ _ hT5i, hT6]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_allNorm,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells newCur).length from
        (Block.toCells_length newCur).symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  -- junction 7: park
  set Wp := (Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ (encodeBlocks mid).reverse
    with hWp
  have hassoc : (Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) =
      Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] := by
    rw [hWp, List.append_assoc]
  have hWp_nb : ∀ c ∈ Wp, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    rw [hWp] at hc
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with h | h
    · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
    · exact encodeBlocks_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
  obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    ((encodeBlocks post ++ G₅).headD TapeSymbol.blank)
    ((encodeBlocks post ++ G₅).tail)
  rw [blankIndex_written Wp [] hWp_nb] at hlt' heq'
  have hlt : ∀ j, j < Wp.length →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[j + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact hlt' j hj
  have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact heq'
  obtain ⟨G₇, hG₇, hret7⟩ := retreat_block Wp [TapeSymbol.blank] post G₅ hG₅
  have hWrev : Wp.reverse = encodeBlocks mid ++ Block.toCells newCur := by
    rw [hWp, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_reverse, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
      ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: post) G₇ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc, hret7]
    obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
        Wp.reverse ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) = r :: R' := by
      rw [hWrev]
      cases hx : encodeBlocks mid ++ Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons,
      show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
        TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
      cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
    have henc : encodeBlocks (mid ++ newCur :: post) =
        encodeBlocks mid ++ (Block.toCells newCur ++ encodeBlocks post) := by
      rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons]
    rw [henc]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i (ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: post) G₇)
    with hT7
  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
    show Function.update T6 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
    rw [hX7]
  have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
      false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
  -- assemble
  have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i allNormWindow T5 _ _ hT5i) htp6
    hP7 htp7
  have hC5 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4) htp5
    hC6.1 hC6.2
  have hC4 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s true) T3 _ _ hT3i)
    htp4 hC5.1 hC5.2
  have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2) htp3
    hC4.1 hC4.2
  have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
  have hC1 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape)
    htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
  refine ⟨G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
  simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin
  exact hfin


/-! ## The right variant, bounded — flag lands on an existing next block -/

theorem updateTrack_right_cons_bounded (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes)
    (s : TapeSymbol) (mid : List Block) (cur nxt : Block) (post' : List Block)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true) :
    ∃ cost, cost ≤ 100 * (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post').length + 300 ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape),
        AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post') G →
        ∃ G', AllBlank G' ∧
          HaltsExactly (updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right)
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).startCfg tape) cost false ∧
          (((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).step^[cost])
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape =
            Function.update tape i
              (ParkedTape (mid ++ setSymFlag side s false cur ::
                setFlag side true nxt :: post') G') := by
  classical
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + ((loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length +
      blockReadSteps) + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 + (0 + 1 + (6 + 1 +
      ((((Block.toCells (setFlag side true nxt)).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells (setSymFlag side s false cur)).reverse ++
          (encodeBlocks mid).reverse)).length) * 4 + 3)))))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [loopCost_const, blockReadSteps_eq]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_reverse,
      Block.toCells_length, encodeBlocks_length, List.length_cons]
    omega
  intro G tape hG hi
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  set newCur := setSymFlag side s false cur with hnewCur
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post') ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post') ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur (nxt :: post') hmid hcur hT1i
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hsplit : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post') =
      encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') := by
    rw [← encodeBlocks_append]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i, hsplit, List.append_assoc,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp,
      cellsTape_advance]
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) (nxt :: post') G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G₃))) with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
      show (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] =
          (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append]
        simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons],
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T3 _ _ hT3i, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_symWindow, ← hnewCur,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  have h5 : HaltsExactly (moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left)
      ((moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4) 0 true :=
    moveUpTo_spec i 0 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4
  have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left).step^[0])
      ((moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T4 := rfl
  set sNxt := setFlag side true nxt with hsNxt
  have hR4 : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (Block.toCells nxt ++ (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT4i, encodeBlocks_cons, List.append_assoc]
  set T6 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
          ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])))
      (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃)) with hT6
  have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).startCfg T4)).tape = T6 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T4 _ _ hR4, hT6]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_flagWindow, ← hsNxt,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells nxt).length from
        (Block.toCells_length nxt).symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
          ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])))
      (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  set Wp := (Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
    ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ (encodeBlocks mid).reverse)
    with hWp
  have hassoc : (Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])) =
      Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] := by
    rw [hWp]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  have hWp_nb : ∀ c ∈ Wp, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    rw [hWp] at hc
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with h | h
    · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h' | h'
      · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h')
      · exact encodeBlocks_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h')
  obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    ((encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃).headD TapeSymbol.blank)
    ((encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃).tail)
  rw [blankIndex_written Wp [] hWp_nb] at hlt' heq'
  have hlt : ∀ j, j < Wp.length →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[j + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact hlt' j hj
  have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact heq'
  obtain ⟨G₇, hG₇, hret7⟩ := retreat_block Wp [TapeSymbol.blank] post' G₃ hG₃
  have hWrev : Wp.reverse = encodeBlocks mid ++
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ Block.toCells sNxt) := by
    rw [hWp]
    simp [List.reverse_append]
  have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
      ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: sNxt :: post') G₇ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc, hret7]
    obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
        Wp.reverse ++ (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₇) = r :: R' := by
      rw [hWrev]
      cases hx : encodeBlocks mid ++
          (Block.toCells newCur ++ Block.toCells sNxt) ++
          (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₇) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons,
      show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
        TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
      cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
    have henc : encodeBlocks (mid ++ newCur :: sNxt :: post') =
        encodeBlocks mid ++ (Block.toCells newCur ++
          (Block.toCells sNxt ++ encodeBlocks post')) := by
      rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons, encodeBlocks_cons]
    rw [henc]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i
    (ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: sNxt :: post') G₇) with hT7
  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
    show Function.update T6 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
    rw [hX7]
  have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
      false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
  have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (flagWindow side) T4 _ _ hR4)
    htp6 hP7 htp7
  have hC5 := chainStep h5 htp5 hC6.1 hC6.2
  have hC4 := chainStep
    (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s false) T3 _ _ hT3i) htp4
    hC5.1 hC5.2
  have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
    htp3 hC4.1 hC4.2
  have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
  have hC1 := chainStep
    (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape) htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
  refine ⟨G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hT7, hT6, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
  simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin
  exact hfin


/-! ## The right variant, bounded — flag materialises a fresh block -/

theorem updateTrack_right_nil_bounded (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes)
    (s : TapeSymbol) (mid : List Block) (cur : Block)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true) :
    ∃ cost, cost ≤ 100 * (mid ++ [cur]).length + 300 ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape),
        AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape (mid ++ [cur]) G →
        ∃ G', AllBlank G' ∧
          HaltsExactly (updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right)
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).startCfg tape) cost false ∧
          (((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).step^[cost])
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape =
            Function.update tape i
              (ParkedTape
                (mid ++ [setSymFlag side s false cur, freshFlagged side])
                G') := by
  classical
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + ((loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length +
      blockReadSteps) + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 + (0 + 1 + (6 + 1 +
      ((((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells (setSymFlag side s false cur)).reverse ++
          (encodeBlocks mid).reverse)).length) * 4 + 3)))))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [loopCost_const, blockReadSteps_eq]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_reverse,
      Block.toCells_length, encodeBlocks_length, List.length_cons]
    omega
  intro G tape hG hi
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  set newCur := setSymFlag side s false cur with hnewCur
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur [] hmid hcur hT1i
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks ([] : List Block) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp]
    have h := cellsTape_advance (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]))
      [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    simpa using h
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) [] G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks ([] : List Block) ++ G₃)))
    with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
