      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T3 _ _ hT3i, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_symWindow, ← hnewCur,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  obtain ⟨G₅, hG₅, hret5⟩ := retreat_block
    ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) [] post G₃ hG₃
  have hret5' : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[7]
      (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) =
      cellsTape [] (TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    have h7 : (7 : Nat) =
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]).length := by
      simp [Block.toCells_length]
    rw [h7]
    have h := hret5
    rw [List.append_nil] at h
    rw [h]
    simp [List.reverse_append]
  have hX5 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[12] (T4 i) =
      cellsTape [] (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT4i, show (12 : Nat) = 5 + 7 from rfl,
      Function.iterate_add_apply, hret5']
    exact cellsTape_retreat_past 5 TapeSymbol.blank
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape [] (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
      TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT5
  have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 12 HeadMove.left).step^[12])
      ((moveUpTo i 12 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 12 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4, hT5]
    exact congrArg (Function.update T4 i) hX5
  have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape []
      (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT5]; simp
  have hR5eq : List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
      TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) =
      List.replicate 6 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [show List.replicate 6 TapeSymbol.blank =
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] from
        List.replicate_succ' .. ]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  have hpatch : patchCellsN 6 (flagWindow side)
      (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) =
      Block.toCells (freshFlagged side) := by
    rw [hR5eq]
    rw [patchCellsN_congr_prefix 6 (flagWindow side) _
      (List.replicate 6 TapeSymbol.blank)
      (by rw [List.take_left' (by simp), List.take_of_length_le (by simp)])]
    exact patchCellsN_flagWindow_fresh side _
      (fun c hc => (List.eq_of_mem_replicate hc))
  have hdrop : (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
      TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).drop 6 =
      Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) := by
    rw [hR5eq, List.drop_left' (by simp)]
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse)
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT6
  have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T5 _ _ hT5i, hT6]
    refine congrArg (Function.update T5 i) ?_
    rw [hpatch, hdrop]
    simp
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse)
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  have hW_nb : ∀ c ∈ (Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse,
      c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp hc)
  obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec
    ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse)
    ((Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).headD
      TapeSymbol.blank)
    ((Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).tail)
  rw [blankIndex_all _ hW_nb] at hlt' heq'
  have hWl : ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse).length = 6 := by
    simp [Block.toCells_length]
  have hlt : ∀ j, j < 6 →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[j + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hT6i]
    exact hlt' j (by omega)
  have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[6 + 1] (T6 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hT6i]
    have h := heq'
    rw [hWl] at h
    exact h
  have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[6 + 1] (T6 i) =
      ParkedTape (freshFlagged side :: newCur :: post) G₅ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i]
    obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
        Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) = r :: R' := by
      cases hx : Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons, show (6 : Nat) =
        ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse).length from hWl.symm]
    rw [cellsTape_retreat_nilL, List.reverse_reverse, ← hcons]
    obtain ⟨r₂, R₂, hcons₂⟩ : ∃ r₂ R₂,
        Block.toCells (freshFlagged side) ++
          (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) = r₂ :: R₂ := by
      cases hx : Block.toCells (freshFlagged side) ++
          (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons₂, cellsTape_moveLeft_nilL, ← hcons₂, ParkedTape]
    simp [encodeBlocks_cons, List.append_assoc]
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i
    (ParkedTape (freshFlagged side :: newCur :: post) G₅) with hT7
  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[6 * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 6 hlt heq, hT7]
    show Function.update T6 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[6 + 1] (T6 i)) = _
    rw [hX7]
  have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (6 * 4 + 3) false :=
    scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 6 hlt heq
  have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (flagWindow side) T5 _ _ hT5i)
    htp6 hP7 htp7
  have hC5 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 12 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4)
    htp5 hC6.1 hC6.2
  have hC4 := chainStep
    (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s false) T3 _ _ hT3i) htp4
    hC5.1 hC5.2
  have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
    htp3 hC4.1 hC4.2
  have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
  have hC1 := chainStep
    (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape) htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
  refine ⟨G₅, hG₅, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
  simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin
  exact hfin


/-! ## The read phase, bounded and ghost-uniform

The published `readPhase_spec` quantifies the ghost *outside* the cost, so each
ghost yields its own opaque cost and a nested phase has no fixed `k` to hand
its continuation.  Here the cost comes first and the ghost and tape are
introduced inside — which is exactly the shape `hcont` consumes, so read
phases nest. -/

theorem readPhase_bounded (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes) {S : Type}
    (cont : TapeSymbol → TypedMachine tapes S)
    (mid : List Block) (cur : Block) (post : List Block)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true)
    (k : Nat) (v : Bool)
    (hcontU : ∀ (G' : List TapeSymbol) (T : Fin tapes → Tape),
      AllBlank G' → T i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G' →
      HaltsExactly (cont (side.pick cur)) ((cont (side.pick cur)).startCfg T)
        k v) :
    ∃ cost, cost ≤ 100 * (mid ++ cur :: post).length + 300 + k ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape),
        AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G →
        ∃ G', AllBlank G' ∧
          HaltsExactly (readPhase side i cont)
            ((readPhase side i cont).startCfg tape) cost v ∧
          ((readPhase side i cont).step^[cost])
            ((readPhase side i cont).startCfg tape) =
            TypedConfiguration.inRight true (TypedConfiguration.inRight false
              (TypedConfiguration.inRight true (TypedConfiguration.inRight
                (sideBit1 side cur) (TypedConfiguration.inRight true
                  (TypedConfiguration.inRight (sideBit2 side cur)
                    (TypedConfiguration.inRight false
                      (((cont (side.pick cur)).step^[k])
                        ((cont (side.pick cur)).startCfg
                          (Function.update tape i
                            (ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G')))))))))) := by
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + ((loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length +
      blockReadSteps) + 1 + (6 + 1 + (blockReadSteps + 1 + (6 + 1 +
      (blockReadSteps + 1 +
      ((((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        (encodeBlocks mid).reverse).length) * 4 + 3 + 1 + k)))))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [loopCost_const, blockReadSteps_eq]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_reverse,
      Block.toCells_length, encodeBlocks_length, List.length_cons]
    omega
  intro G tape hG hi
  have hcont : ∀ (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' →
      HaltsExactly (cont (side.pick cur))
        ((cont (side.pick cur)).startCfg
          (Function.update tape i (ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G'))) k v :=
    fun G' hG' => hcontU G' _ hG' (by simp)
  classical
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  -- ===== junction 1: enter =====
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  -- ===== junction 2: walk =====
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur post hmid hcur hT1i
  set W1 := loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length + blockReadSteps
    with hW1
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hsplit : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) =
      encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ encodeBlocks post := by
    rw [← encodeBlocks_append]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i, hsplit, List.append_assoc,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp,
      cellsTape_advance]
  -- ===== junction 3: back to the flagged block =====
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃))) with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
      show (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] =
          (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append]
        simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons],
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  -- ===== junction 4: first probe =====
  have hread1 : HaltsExactly (blockRead i (sideBit1 side))
      ((blockRead i (sideBit1 side)).startCfg T3) blockReadSteps
      (sideBit1 side cur) := by
    have h := blockRead_spec i (sideBit1 side) T3
    rwa [blockOfCells_cellsTape i T3 _ _ cur hT3i] at h
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((blockRead i (sideBit1 side)).step^[blockReadSteps])
      ((blockRead i (sideBit1 side)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    have h := blockRead_tape i (sideBit1 side) T3
    rw [show (blockRead i (sideBit1 side)).startCfg T3 =
        TypedConfiguration.inLeftState
          ((readCellRight i).startCfg T3) from rfl] at *
    rw [h, hT4]
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      rw [scanTapesDir_self, hT3i,
        show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
        cellsTape_advance]
      simp
    · simp [scanTapesDir, hj]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  -- ===== junction 5: back again =====
  obtain ⟨G₅, hG₅, hret5⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G₃ hG₃
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT5
  have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4, hT5]
    congr 1
    rw [hT4i,
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret5, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT5]; simp
  -- ===== junction 6: second probe =====
  have hread2 : HaltsExactly (blockRead i (sideBit2 side))
      ((blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).startCfg T5) blockReadSteps
      (sideBit2 side cur) := by
    have h := blockRead_spec i (sideBit2 side) T5
    rwa [blockOfCells_cellsTape i T5 _ _ cur hT5i] at h
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) with hT6
  have htp6 : (((blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).step^[blockReadSteps])
      ((blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
    have h := blockRead_tape i (sideBit2 side) T5
    rw [show (blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).startCfg T5 =
        TypedConfiguration.inLeftState
          ((readCellRight i).startCfg T5) from rfl] at *
    rw [h, hT6]
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      rw [scanTapesDir_self, hT5i,
        show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
        cellsTape_advance]
      simp
    · simp [scanTapesDir, hj]
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  -- ===== junction 7: park =====
  set Wp := (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++ (encodeBlocks mid).reverse
    with hWp
  have hassoc : (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) =
      Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] := by
    rw [hWp, List.append_assoc]
  have hWp_nb : ∀ c ∈ Wp, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    rw [hWp] at hc
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with h | h
    · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
    · exact encodeBlocks_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
  obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    ((encodeBlocks post ++ G₅).headD TapeSymbol.blank)
    ((encodeBlocks post ++ G₅).tail)
  rw [blankIndex_written Wp [] hWp_nb] at hlt' heq'
  have hlt : ∀ j, j < Wp.length →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[j + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact hlt' j hj
  have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact heq'
  obtain ⟨G₇, hG₇, hret7⟩ := retreat_block Wp [TapeSymbol.blank] post G₅ hG₅
  have hWrev : Wp.reverse = encodeBlocks mid ++ Block.toCells cur := by
    rw [hWp, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_reverse, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
      ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G₇ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc, hret7]
    obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
        Wp.reverse ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) = r :: R' := by
      rw [hWrev]
      cases hx : encodeBlocks mid ++ Block.toCells cur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons,
      show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
        TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
      cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
    have henc : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) =
        encodeBlocks mid ++ (Block.toCells cur ++ encodeBlocks post) := by
      rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons]
    rw [henc]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i (ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G₇)
    with hT7
  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
    show Function.update T6 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
    rw [hX7]
  have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
      false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
  -- ===== the continuation's start =====
  have hT7flat : T7 = Function.update tape i
      (ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G₇) := by
    rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1]
    simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem]
  have hK := hcont G₇ hG₇
  rw [← hT7flat] at hK
  -- ===== assemble, inside out =====
  have hsym : symbolOfBits (sideBit1 side cur) (sideBit2 side cur) =
      side.pick cur := symbolOfBits_decode side cur
  have hC7 := chainStepD
    (M₂ := fun _ => cont (symbolOfBits (sideBit1 side cur)
      (sideBit2 side cur)))
    hP7 htp7 (by rw [hsym]; exact hK)
  have hC6 := chainStepD
    (M₂ := fun b₂ => (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
      cont (symbolOfBits (sideBit1 side cur) b₂))
    hread2 htp6 hC7.1
  have hC5 := chainStepC (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4)
    htp5 hC6.1
  have hC4 := chainStepD
    (M₂ := fun b₁ => (moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
      (blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).andThen fun b₂ =>
        (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
          cont (symbolOfBits b₁ b₂))
    hread1 htp4 hC5.1
  have hC3 := chainStepC (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
    htp3 hC4.1
  have hC2 := chainStepC hw hwt hC3.1
  have hC1 := chainStepC (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape)
    htp1 hC2.1
  rw [show cont (side.pick cur) = cont (symbolOfBits (sideBit1 side cur)
    (sideBit2 side cur)) by rw [hsym]]
  refine ⟨G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hC2.2] at hfin
  rw [hC3.2] at hfin
  rw [hC4.2] at hfin
  rw [hC5.2] at hfin
  rw [hC6.2] at hfin
  rw [hC7.2] at hfin
  rw [hT7flat] at hfin
  exact hfin

end SipserGacsLautemann
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Bounded, ghost-uniform specifications: the repair that unblocks the final assembly.

The published update and read-phase specifications hide their costs behind an existential quantified *after* the ghost. Two consumers break on that, and both breaks are fatal rather than cosmetic:

**Polynomial accounting.** `DecidesInPolynomialTime` demands a uniform polynomial time bound, and the simulation's total is $\sum_t (\mathrm{cost}_t + 1)$ plus a final round. An opaque per-round cost cannot be summed, and the value is not recoverable after the fact: the halting time of a `HaltsExactly` is unique, but proving $t \le B$ requires a firing-at-$B$ fact that only a re-derivation supplies.

**Nested phases.** A read phase's continuation hypothesis needs one *fixed* cost for **every** ghost. With the ghost quantified outside the cost, each ghost instantiation produces its own opaque cost and no uniform value exists — even though the underlying costs are visibly ghost-independent.

This module restates all six specifications in the corrected shape: cost first with an affine bound in the region size, ghost and tape introduced inside. The four update variants become separate theorems — `stay`, `right_cons`, `right_nil`, `left_concat`, `left_nil` — so each names its own result region rather than hiding an edge case behind a match, and `readPhase_bounded` gains the ∀-tape form its own nesting requires. Every cost is bounded by $100\,|{\rm blocks}| + 300$ (plus the continuation's $k$ for the read phase); the constants are deliberately generous, since only polynomiality is at stake.

**Formalization note.** The proofs are the original chain constructions with the cost expression supplied up front — the exact nested sum the chain accumulates, written in statement-level terms — and the bound discharged by `loopCost_const` together with length facts and `omega`. This works because `set` folds the goal's occurrences into the same names the chain produces, so the pre-supplied expression unifies with what the junctions build.
theorems.source: Restatement of the two-track simulation's update and read specifications with explicit affine cost bounds; builds on Def_sgl_step_program.
theorems.theorem_title: Bounded, ghost-uniform update and read specifications

theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_step_program

/-!
# Bounded, ghost-uniform specifications

Module E3a of the merge_empty plan (`DESIGN_E3_F.md` §1.1).

The published update and read-phase specifications hide their costs behind an
existential, quantified *after* the ghost.  Two consumers break on that: the
final polynomial accounting cannot bound an opaque per-round cost, and a
nested phase's `hcont` needs one fixed cost **for every ghost**.  The costs
are in fact ghost-independent and affinely bounded — the statements just
failed to say so.

This module restates them in the corrected shape

```
∃ cost, cost ≤ ⟨affine in the region size⟩ ∧
  ∀ G tape, AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape … G → ⟨the original conclusion⟩
```

— cost first, bound alongside, ghost and tape inside.  The proofs are the
original chain constructions with the cost supplied up front; the edge cases
become separate theorems (`right_cons`/`right_nil`, `left_concat`/`left_nil`)
so each statement names its own result region.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-- `blockReadSteps` is twelve. -/
theorem blockReadSteps_eq : blockReadSteps = 12 := rfl

/-! ## The stay variant, bounded -/

theorem updateTrack_stay_bounded (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes)
    (s : TapeSymbol) (mid : List Block) (cur : Block) (post : List Block)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true) :
    ∃ cost, cost ≤ 100 * (mid ++ cur :: post).length + 300 ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape),
        AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G →
        ∃ G', AllBlank G' ∧
          HaltsExactly (updateTrack side i s HeadMove.stay)
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.stay).startCfg tape) cost false ∧
          (((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.stay).step^[cost])
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.stay).startCfg tape)).tape =
            Function.update tape i
              (ParkedTape (mid ++ setSymFlag side s true cur :: post) G') := by
  classical
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + ((loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length +
      blockReadSteps) + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 +
      ((((Block.toCells (setSymFlag side s true cur)).reverse ++
        (encodeBlocks mid).reverse).length) * 4 + 3)))))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [loopCost_const, blockReadSteps_eq]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_reverse,
      Block.toCells_length, encodeBlocks_length, List.length_cons]
    omega
  intro G tape hG hi
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  set newCur := setSymFlag side s true cur with hnewCur
  -- junction 1: enter
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  -- junction 2: walk
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur post hmid hcur hT1i
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hsplit : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) =
      encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ encodeBlocks post := by
    rw [← encodeBlocks_append]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i, hsplit, List.append_assoc,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp,
      cellsTape_advance]
  -- junction 3: back onto the flagged block
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃))) with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
      show (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] =
          (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append]
        simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons],
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  -- junction 4: rewrite the flagged block
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s true)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s true)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T3 _ _ hT3i, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_symWindow, ← hnewCur,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  -- junction 5: retreat again
  obtain ⟨G₅, hG₅, hret5⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells newCur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G₃ hG₃
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT5
  have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4, hT5]
    congr 1
    rw [hT4i,
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse).length by
        simp [Block.toCells_length]]
    rw [hret5, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT5]; simp
  -- junction 6: identity window
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) with hT6
  have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i allNormWindow).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i allNormWindow).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T5 _ _ hT5i, hT6]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_allNorm,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells newCur).length from
        (Block.toCells_length newCur).symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  -- junction 7: park
  set Wp := (Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ (encodeBlocks mid).reverse
    with hWp
  have hassoc : (Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) =
      Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] := by
    rw [hWp, List.append_assoc]
  have hWp_nb : ∀ c ∈ Wp, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    rw [hWp] at hc
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with h | h
    · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
    · exact encodeBlocks_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
  obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    ((encodeBlocks post ++ G₅).headD TapeSymbol.blank)
    ((encodeBlocks post ++ G₅).tail)
  rw [blankIndex_written Wp [] hWp_nb] at hlt' heq'
  have hlt : ∀ j, j < Wp.length →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[j + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact hlt' j hj
  have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact heq'
  obtain ⟨G₇, hG₇, hret7⟩ := retreat_block Wp [TapeSymbol.blank] post G₅ hG₅
  have hWrev : Wp.reverse = encodeBlocks mid ++ Block.toCells newCur := by
    rw [hWp, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_reverse, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
      ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: post) G₇ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc, hret7]
    obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
        Wp.reverse ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) = r :: R' := by
      rw [hWrev]
      cases hx : encodeBlocks mid ++ Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons,
      show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
        TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
      cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
    have henc : encodeBlocks (mid ++ newCur :: post) =
        encodeBlocks mid ++ (Block.toCells newCur ++ encodeBlocks post) := by
      rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons]
    rw [henc]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i (ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: post) G₇)
    with hT7
  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
    show Function.update T6 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
    rw [hX7]
  have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
      false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
  -- assemble
  have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i allNormWindow T5 _ _ hT5i) htp6
    hP7 htp7
  have hC5 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4) htp5
    hC6.1 hC6.2
  have hC4 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s true) T3 _ _ hT3i)
    htp4 hC5.1 hC5.2
  have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2) htp3
    hC4.1 hC4.2
  have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
  have hC1 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape)
    htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
  refine ⟨G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
  simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin
  exact hfin


/-! ## The right variant, bounded — flag lands on an existing next block -/

theorem updateTrack_right_cons_bounded (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes)
    (s : TapeSymbol) (mid : List Block) (cur nxt : Block) (post' : List Block)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true) :
    ∃ cost, cost ≤ 100 * (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post').length + 300 ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape),
        AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post') G →
        ∃ G', AllBlank G' ∧
          HaltsExactly (updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right)
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).startCfg tape) cost false ∧
          (((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).step^[cost])
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape =
            Function.update tape i
              (ParkedTape (mid ++ setSymFlag side s false cur ::
                setFlag side true nxt :: post') G') := by
  classical
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + ((loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length +
      blockReadSteps) + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 + (0 + 1 + (6 + 1 +
      ((((Block.toCells (setFlag side true nxt)).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells (setSymFlag side s false cur)).reverse ++
          (encodeBlocks mid).reverse)).length) * 4 + 3)))))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [loopCost_const, blockReadSteps_eq]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_reverse,
      Block.toCells_length, encodeBlocks_length, List.length_cons]
    omega
  intro G tape hG hi
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  set newCur := setSymFlag side s false cur with hnewCur
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post') ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post') ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur (nxt :: post') hmid hcur hT1i
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hsplit : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: nxt :: post') =
      encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') := by
    rw [← encodeBlocks_append]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i, hsplit, List.append_assoc,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp,
      cellsTape_advance]
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) (nxt :: post') G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G₃))) with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
      show (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] =
          (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append]
        simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons],
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T3 _ _ hT3i, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_symWindow, ← hnewCur,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks (nxt :: post') ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  have h5 : HaltsExactly (moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left)
      ((moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4) 0 true :=
    moveUpTo_spec i 0 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4
  have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left).step^[0])
      ((moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T4 := rfl
  set sNxt := setFlag side true nxt with hsNxt
  have hR4 : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (Block.toCells nxt ++ (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT4i, encodeBlocks_cons, List.append_assoc]
  set T6 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
          ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])))
      (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃)) with hT6
  have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).startCfg T4)).tape = T6 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T4 _ _ hR4, hT6]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_flagWindow, ← hsNxt,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells nxt).length from
        (Block.toCells_length nxt).symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
          ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])))
      (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  set Wp := (Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
    ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ (encodeBlocks mid).reverse)
    with hWp
  have hassoc : (Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])) =
      Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] := by
    rw [hWp]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  have hWp_nb : ∀ c ∈ Wp, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    rw [hWp] at hc
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with h | h
    · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h' | h'
      · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h')
      · exact encodeBlocks_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h')
  obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    ((encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃).headD TapeSymbol.blank)
    ((encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃).tail)
  rw [blankIndex_written Wp [] hWp_nb] at hlt' heq'
  have hlt : ∀ j, j < Wp.length →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[j + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact hlt' j hj
  have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact heq'
  obtain ⟨G₇, hG₇, hret7⟩ := retreat_block Wp [TapeSymbol.blank] post' G₃ hG₃
  have hWrev : Wp.reverse = encodeBlocks mid ++
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ Block.toCells sNxt) := by
    rw [hWp]
    simp [List.reverse_append]
  have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
      ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: sNxt :: post') G₇ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc, hret7]
    obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
        Wp.reverse ++ (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₇) = r :: R' := by
      rw [hWrev]
      cases hx : encodeBlocks mid ++
          (Block.toCells newCur ++ Block.toCells sNxt) ++
          (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₇) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons,
      show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
        TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
      cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
    have henc : encodeBlocks (mid ++ newCur :: sNxt :: post') =
        encodeBlocks mid ++ (Block.toCells newCur ++
          (Block.toCells sNxt ++ encodeBlocks post')) := by
      rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons, encodeBlocks_cons]
    rw [henc]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i
    (ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: sNxt :: post') G₇) with hT7
  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]

/-! ## The right variant, bounded — flag materialises a fresh block -/

theorem updateTrack_right_nil_bounded (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes)
    (s : TapeSymbol) (mid : List Block) (cur : Block)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true) :
    ∃ cost, cost ≤ 100 * (mid ++ [cur]).length + 300 ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape),

            Function.update tape i

      blockReadSteps) + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 + (0 + 1 + (6 + 1 +
      ((((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells (setSymFlag side s false cur)).reverse ++

    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ G)) with hT1

      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur [] hmid hcur hT1i
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks ([] : List Block) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp]

      [TapeSymbol.blank] G

    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) [] G hG

    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks ([] : List Block) ++ G₃)))

    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]

    rw [hT2i,
      show (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] =
          (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append]
        simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons],
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]

    simp [List.reverse_append]

    rw [henc]

    htp6 hP7 htp7
  have hC5 := chainStep h5 htp5 hC6.1 hC6.2
  have hC4 := chainStep

  have hC1 := chainStep
    (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape) htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
  refine ⟨G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hT7, hT6, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
  simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin

  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
    show Function.update T6 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
    rw [hX7]
  have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
      false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
  have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (flagWindow side) T5 _ _ hT5i)
    htp6 hP7 htp7
  have hC5 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 12 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4)
    htp5 hC6.1 hC6.2
  have hC4 := chainStep
    (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s false) T3 _ _ hT3i) htp4
    hC5.1 hC5.2
  have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
    htp3 hC4.1 hC4.2
  have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
  have hC1 := chainStep
    (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape) htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
  refine ⟨G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
  simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin
  exact hfin


/-! ## The left variant, bounded — flag materialises before the region -/

theorem updateTrack_left_nil_bounded (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes)
    (s : TapeSymbol) (cur : Block) (post : List Block)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true) :
    ∃ cost, cost ≤ 100 * (cur :: post).length + 300 ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape),
        AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape (cur :: post) G →
        ∃ G', AllBlank G' ∧
          HaltsExactly (updateTrack side i s HeadMove.left)
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.left).startCfg tape) cost false ∧
          (((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.left).step^[cost])
            ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.left).startCfg tape)).tape =
            Function.update tape i
              (ParkedTape (freshFlagged side ::
                setSymFlag side s false cur :: post) G') := by
  classical
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + ((loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) ([] : List Block).length +
      blockReadSteps) + 1 + (6 + 1 + (6 + 1 + (12 + 1 + (6 + 1 +
      (6 * 4 + 3)))))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [loopCost_const, blockReadSteps_eq]
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    omega
  intro G tape hG hi
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  set newCur := setSymFlag side s false cur with hnewCur
  have hmid : ∀ b ∈ ([] : List Block), side.getFlag b = false := by
    intro b hb; simp at hb
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (cur :: post) ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks ([] ++ cur :: post) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    [] cur post hmid hcur hT1i
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right
    (6 * (([] : List Block).length + 1)) with hT2
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i]
    simp only [List.length_nil, List.nil_append, encodeBlocks_cons]
    rw [show 6 * (0 + 1) = (Block.toCells cur).length by simp [hCl],
      List.append_assoc]
    exact cellsTape_advance (Block.toCells cur) [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G)
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    [TapeSymbol.blank] post G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃))) with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T3 _ _ hT3i, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_symWindow, ← hnewCur,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  obtain ⟨G₅, hG₅, hret5⟩ := retreat_block
    ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) [] post G₃ hG₃
  have hret5' : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[7]
      (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) =
      cellsTape [] (TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    have h7 : (7 : Nat) =
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]).length := by
      simp [Block.toCells_length]
    rw [h7]
    have h := hret5
    rw [List.append_nil] at h
    rw [h]
    simp [List.reverse_append]
  have hX5 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[12] (T4 i) =
      cellsTape [] (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT4i, show (12 : Nat) = 5 + 7 from rfl,
      Function.iterate_add_apply, hret5']
    exact cellsTape_retreat_past 5 TapeSymbol.blank
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape [] (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
      TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT5
  have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 12 HeadMove.left).step^[12])
      ((moveUpTo i 12 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 12 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4, hT5]
    exact congrArg (Function.update T4 i) hX5
  have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape []
      (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT5]; simp
  have hR5eq : List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
      TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) =
      List.replicate 6 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [show List.replicate 6 TapeSymbol.blank =
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] from
        List.replicate_succ' .. ]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  have hpatch : patchCellsN 6 (flagWindow side)
      (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) =
      Block.toCells (freshFlagged side) := by
    rw [hR5eq]
    rw [patchCellsN_congr_prefix 6 (flagWindow side) _
      (List.replicate 6 TapeSymbol.blank)
      (by rw [List.take_left' (by simp), List.take_of_length_le (by simp)])]
    exact patchCellsN_flagWindow_fresh side _
      (fun c hc => (List.eq_of_mem_replicate hc))
  have hdrop : (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
      TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).drop 6 =
      Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) := by
    rw [hR5eq, List.drop_left' (by simp)]
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse)
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT6
  have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T5 _ _ hT5i, hT6]
    refine congrArg (Function.update T5 i) ?_
    rw [hpatch, hdrop]
    simp
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse)
      (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  have hW_nb : ∀ c ∈ (Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse,
      c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp hc)
  obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec
    ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse)
    ((Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).headD
      TapeSymbol.blank)
    ((Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).tail)
  rw [blankIndex_all _ hW_nb] at hlt' heq'
  have hWl : ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse).length = 6 := by
    simp [Block.toCells_length]
  have hlt : ∀ j, j < 6 →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[j + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hT6i]
    exact hlt' j (by omega)
  have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[6 + 1] (T6 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hT6i]
    have h := heq'
    rw [hWl] at h
    exact h
  have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[6 + 1] (T6 i) =
      ParkedTape (freshFlagged side :: newCur :: post) G₅ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i]
    obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
        Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) = r :: R' := by
      cases hx : Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons, show (6 : Nat) =
        ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse).length from hWl.symm]
    rw [cellsTape_retreat_nilL, List.reverse_reverse, ← hcons]
    obtain ⟨r₂, R₂, hcons₂⟩ : ∃ r₂ R₂,
        Block.toCells (freshFlagged side) ++
          (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) = r₂ :: R₂ := by
      cases hx : Block.toCells (freshFlagged side) ++
          (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons₂, cellsTape_moveLeft_nilL, ← hcons₂, ParkedTape]
    simp [encodeBlocks_cons, List.append_assoc]
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i
    (ParkedTape (freshFlagged side :: newCur :: post) G₅) with hT7
  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[6 * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 6 hlt heq, hT7]
    show Function.update T6 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[6 + 1] (T6 i)) = _
    rw [hX7]
  have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (6 * 4 + 3) false :=
    scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 6 hlt heq
  have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (flagWindow side) T5 _ _ hT5i)
    htp6 hP7 htp7
  have hC5 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 12 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4)
    htp5 hC6.1 hC6.2
  have hC4 := chainStep
    (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s false) T3 _ _ hT3i) htp4
    hC5.1 hC5.2
  have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
    htp3 hC4.1 hC4.2
  have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
  have hC1 := chainStep
    (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape) htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
  refine ⟨G₅, hG₅, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
  simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin
  exact hfin


/-! ## The read phase, bounded and ghost-uniform

The published `readPhase_spec` quantifies the ghost *outside* the cost, so each
ghost yields its own opaque cost and a nested phase has no fixed `k` to hand
its continuation.  Here the cost comes first and the ghost and tape are
introduced inside — which is exactly the shape `hcont` consumes, so read
phases nest. -/

theorem readPhase_bounded (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes) {S : Type}
    (cont : TapeSymbol → TypedMachine tapes S)
    (mid : List Block) (cur : Block) (post : List Block)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true)
    (k : Nat) (v : Bool)
    (hcontU : ∀ (G' : List TapeSymbol) (T : Fin tapes → Tape),
      AllBlank G' → T i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G' →
      HaltsExactly (cont (side.pick cur)) ((cont (side.pick cur)).startCfg T)
        k v) :
    ∃ cost, cost ≤ 100 * (mid ++ cur :: post).length + 300 + k ∧
      ∀ (G : List TapeSymbol) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape),
        AllBlank G → tape i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G →
        ∃ G', AllBlank G' ∧
          HaltsExactly (readPhase side i cont)
            ((readPhase side i cont).startCfg tape) cost v ∧
          ((readPhase side i cont).step^[cost])
            ((readPhase side i cont).startCfg tape) =
            TypedConfiguration.inRight true (TypedConfiguration.inRight false
              (TypedConfiguration.inRight true (TypedConfiguration.inRight
                (sideBit1 side cur) (TypedConfiguration.inRight true
                  (TypedConfiguration.inRight (sideBit2 side cur)
                    (TypedConfiguration.inRight false
                      (((cont (side.pick cur)).step^[k])
                        ((cont (side.pick cur)).startCfg
                          (Function.update tape i
                            (ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G')))))))))) := by
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + ((loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length +
      blockReadSteps) + 1 + (6 + 1 + (blockReadSteps + 1 + (6 + 1 +
      (blockReadSteps + 1 +
      ((((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        (encodeBlocks mid).reverse).length) * 4 + 3 + 1 + k)))))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [loopCost_const, blockReadSteps_eq]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_reverse,
      Block.toCells_length, encodeBlocks_length, List.length_cons]
    omega
  intro G tape hG hi
  have hcont : ∀ (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' →
      HaltsExactly (cont (side.pick cur))
        ((cont (side.pick cur)).startCfg
          (Function.update tape i (ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G'))) k v :=
    fun G' hG' => hcontU G' _ hG' (by simp)
  classical
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  -- ===== junction 1: enter =====
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  -- ===== junction 2: walk =====
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur post hmid hcur hT1i
  set W1 := loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length + blockReadSteps
    with hW1
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hsplit : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) =
      encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ encodeBlocks post := by
    rw [← encodeBlocks_append]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i, hsplit, List.append_assoc,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp,
      cellsTape_advance]
  -- ===== junction 3: back to the flagged block =====
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃))) with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
      show (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] =
          (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append]
        simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons],
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  -- ===== junction 4: first probe =====
  have hread1 : HaltsExactly (blockRead i (sideBit1 side))
      ((blockRead i (sideBit1 side)).startCfg T3) blockReadSteps
      (sideBit1 side cur) := by
    have h := blockRead_spec i (sideBit1 side) T3
    rwa [blockOfCells_cellsTape i T3 _ _ cur hT3i] at h
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((blockRead i (sideBit1 side)).step^[blockReadSteps])
      ((blockRead i (sideBit1 side)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    have h := blockRead_tape i (sideBit1 side) T3
    rw [show (blockRead i (sideBit1 side)).startCfg T3 =
        TypedConfiguration.inLeftState
          ((readCellRight i).startCfg T3) from rfl] at *
    rw [h, hT4]
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      rw [scanTapesDir_self, hT3i,
        show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
        cellsTape_advance]
      simp
    · simp [scanTapesDir, hj]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  -- ===== junction 5: back again =====
  obtain ⟨G₅, hG₅, hret5⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G₃ hG₃
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT5
  have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4, hT5]
    congr 1
    rw [hT4i,
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret5, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
    rw [hT5]; simp
  -- ===== junction 6: second probe =====
  have hread2 : HaltsExactly (blockRead i (sideBit2 side))
      ((blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).startCfg T5) blockReadSteps
      (sideBit2 side cur) := by
    have h := blockRead_spec i (sideBit2 side) T5
    rwa [blockOfCells_cellsTape i T5 _ _ cur hT5i] at h
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) with hT6
  have htp6 : (((blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).step^[blockReadSteps])
      ((blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
    have h := blockRead_tape i (sideBit2 side) T5
    rw [show (blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).startCfg T5 =
        TypedConfiguration.inLeftState
          ((readCellRight i).startCfg T5) from rfl] at *
    rw [h, hT6]
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      rw [scanTapesDir_self, hT5i,
        show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
        cellsTape_advance]
      simp
    · simp [scanTapesDir, hj]
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  -- ===== junction 7: park =====
  set Wp := (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++ (encodeBlocks mid).reverse
    with hWp
  have hassoc : (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) =
      Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] := by
    rw [hWp, List.append_assoc]
  have hWp_nb : ∀ c ∈ Wp, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    rw [hWp] at hc
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with h | h
    · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
    · exact encodeBlocks_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
  obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    ((encodeBlocks post ++ G₅).headD TapeSymbol.blank)
    ((encodeBlocks post ++ G₅).tail)
  rw [blankIndex_written Wp [] hWp_nb] at hlt' heq'
  have hlt : ∀ j, j < Wp.length →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[j + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact hlt' j hj
  have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hT6i, hassoc]
    exact heq'
  obtain ⟨G₇, hG₇, hret7⟩ := retreat_block Wp [TapeSymbol.blank] post G₅ hG₅
  have hWrev : Wp.reverse = encodeBlocks mid ++ Block.toCells cur := by
    rw [hWp, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_reverse, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
      ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G₇ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc, hret7]
    obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
        Wp.reverse ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) = r :: R' := by
      rw [hWrev]
      cases hx : encodeBlocks mid ++ Block.toCells cur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons,
      show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
        TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
      cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
    have henc : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) =
        encodeBlocks mid ++ (Block.toCells cur ++ encodeBlocks post) := by
      rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons]
    rw [henc]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i (ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G₇)
    with hT7
  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
    show Function.update T6 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
    rw [hX7]
  have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
      false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
  -- ===== the continuation's start =====
  have hT7flat : T7 = Function.update tape i
      (ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G₇) := by
    rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1]
    simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem]
  have hK := hcont G₇ hG₇
  rw [← hT7flat] at hK
  -- ===== assemble, inside out =====
  have hsym : symbolOfBits (sideBit1 side cur) (sideBit2 side cur) =
      side.pick cur := symbolOfBits_decode side cur
  have hC7 := chainStepD
    (M₂ := fun _ => cont (symbolOfBits (sideBit1 side cur)
      (sideBit2 side cur)))
    hP7 htp7 (by rw [hsym]; exact hK)
  have hC6 := chainStepD
    (M₂ := fun b₂ => (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
      cont (symbolOfBits (sideBit1 side cur) b₂))
    hread2 htp6 hC7.1
  have hC5 := chainStepC (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4)
    htp5 hC6.1
  have hC4 := chainStepD
    (M₂ := fun b₁ => (moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
      (blockRead i (sideBit2 side)).andThen fun b₂ =>
        (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
          cont (symbolOfBits b₁ b₂))
    hread1 htp4 hC5.1
  have hC3 := chainStepC (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
    htp3 hC4.1
  have hC2 := chainStepC hw hwt hC3.1
  have hC1 := chainStepC (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape)
    htp1 hC2.1
  rw [show cont (side.pick cur) = cont (symbolOfBits (sideBit1 side cur)
    (sideBit2 side cur)) by rw [hsym]]
  refine ⟨G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hC2.2] at hfin
  rw [hC3.2] at hfin
  rw [hC4.2] at hfin
  rw [hC5.2] at hfin
  rw [hC6.2] at hfin
  rw [hC7.2] at hfin
  rw [hT7flat] at hfin
  exact hfin

end SipserGacsLautemann
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Bounded, ghost-uniform specifications: the repair that unblocks the final assembly.

The published update and read-phase specifications hide their costs behind an existential quantified *after* the ghost. Two consumers break on that, and both breaks are fatal rather than cosmetic:

**Polynomial accounting.** `DecidesInPolynomialTime` demands a uniform polynomial time bound, and the simulation's total is $\sum_t (\mathrm{cost}_t + 1)$ plus a final round. An opaque per-round cost cannot be summed, and the value is not recoverable after the fact: the halting time of a `HaltsExactly` is unique, but proving $t \le B$ requires a firing-at-$B$ fact that only a re-derivation supplies.

**Nested phases.** A read phase's continuation hypothesis needs one *fixed* cost for **every** ghost. With the ghost quantified outside the cost, each ghost instantiation produces its own opaque cost and no uniform value exists — even though the underlying costs are visibly ghost-independent.

This module restates all six specifications in the corrected shape: cost first with an affine bound in the region size, ghost and tape introduced inside. The four update variants become separate theorems — `stay`, `right_cons`, `right_nil`, `left_concat`, `left_nil` — so each names its own result region rather than hiding an edge case behind a match, and `readPhase_bounded` gains the ∀-tape form its own nesting requires. Every cost is bounded by $100\,|{\rm blocks}| + 300$ (plus the continuation's $k$ for the read phase); the constants are deliberately generous, since only polynomiality is at stake.

**Formalization note.** The proofs are the original chain constructions with the cost expression supplied up front — the exact nested sum the chain accumulates, written in statement-level terms — and the bound discharged by `loopCost_const` together with length facts and `omega`. This works because `set` folds the goal's occurrences into the same names the chain produces, so the pre-supplied expression unifies with what the junctions build.

import Definitions.Def_sgl_read_bits

/-!
# Configuration-tracking composition

Module E of the merge_empty plan, third part: the chaining tools for the step
program.

The outer simulation loop's `LoopRound` record evaluates `next`, `stop` and
`verdict` on the round body's **terminal state**, so the step program's
specification must pin its final configuration exactly — tapes *and* state.
`chainStepC` and `chainStepD` are the config-tracking forms of `chainStep`:
each junction contributes one `inRight` layer to an explicit nested terminal
term, on which those functions evaluate by `rfl`.

At the chain's end sits `carryQ`, whose one job is to place the simulated
machine's next state into the terminal term where a shallow peel can find it.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-! ## Config-tracking chain steps -/

/-- Constant continuation, full final configuration. -/
theorem chainStepC {S₁ S₂ : Type} {M₁ : TypedMachine tapes S₁}
    {M₂ : TypedMachine tapes S₂} {T T' : Fin tapes → Tape}
    {a : Nat} {b : Bool} {k : Nat} {v : Bool}
    (h₁ : HaltsExactly M₁ (M₁.startCfg T) a b)
    (htp : ((M₁.step^[a]) (M₁.startCfg T)).tape = T')
    (h₂ : HaltsExactly M₂ (M₂.startCfg T') k v) :
    HaltsExactly (M₁.andThen fun _ => M₂)
        ((M₁.andThen fun _ => M₂).startCfg T) (a + 1 + k) v ∧
      ((M₁.andThen fun _ => M₂).step^[a + 1 + k])
        ((M₁.andThen fun _ => M₂).startCfg T) =
        TypedConfiguration.inRight b ((M₂.step^[k]) (M₂.startCfg T')) := by
  constructor
  · exact HaltsExactly.andThen (M₂ := fun _ => M₂) h₁ (by rw [htp]; exact h₂)
  · have hcfg : (M₁.andThen fun _ => M₂).startCfg T =
        TypedConfiguration.inLeft (M₁.startCfg T) := rfl
    rw [hcfg, TypedMachine.andThen_iterate M₁ (fun _ => M₂) _ a b h₁.halts
      h₁.fresh k, htp]
    rfl

/-- Verdict-dispatching continuation, full final configuration. -/
theorem chainStepD {S₁ S₂ : Type} {M₁ : TypedMachine tapes S₁}
    (M₂ : Bool → TypedMachine tapes S₂) {T T' : Fin tapes → Tape}
    {a : Nat} {b : Bool} {k : Nat} {v : Bool}
    (h₁ : HaltsExactly M₁ (M₁.startCfg T) a b)
    (htp : ((M₁.step^[a]) (M₁.startCfg T)).tape = T')
    (h₂ : HaltsExactly (M₂ b) ((M₂ b).startCfg T') k v) :
    HaltsExactly (M₁.andThen M₂) ((M₁.andThen M₂).startCfg T) (a + 1 + k) v ∧
      ((M₁.andThen M₂).step^[a + 1 + k]) ((M₁.andThen M₂).startCfg T) =
        TypedConfiguration.inRight b
          (((M₂ b).step^[k]) ((M₂ b).startCfg T')) := by
  constructor
  · exact HaltsExactly.andThen h₁ (by rw [htp]; exact h₂)
  · have hcfg : (M₁.andThen M₂).startCfg T =
        TypedConfiguration.inLeft (M₁.startCfg T) := rfl
    rw [hcfg, TypedMachine.andThen_iterate M₁ M₂ _ a b h₁.halts h₁.fresh k,
      htp]
    rfl

/-- State-dispatching continuation (through `andThenState`), full final
configuration.  The first machine's exit state is remembered in the composite's
terminal term. -/
theorem chainStepS {S₁ S₂ : Type} {M₁ : TypedMachine tapes S₁}
    {exit : S₁ → Bool} (M₂ : S₁ → TypedMachine tapes S₂)
    {T T' : Fin tapes → Tape} {a : Nat} {st : S₁} {k : Nat} {v : Bool}
    (hexit : exit ((M₁.step^[a]) (M₁.startCfg T)).state = true)
    (hfresh : ∀ j, j < a →
      exit ((M₁.step^[j]) (M₁.startCfg T)).state = false)
    (hst : ((M₁.step^[a]) (M₁.startCfg T)).state = st)
    (htp : ((M₁.step^[a]) (M₁.startCfg T)).tape = T')
    (h₂ : HaltsExactly (M₂ st) ((M₂ st).startCfg T') k v) :
    HaltsExactly (M₁.andThenState exit M₂)
        ((M₁.andThenState exit M₂).startCfg T) (a + 1 + k) v ∧
      ((M₁.andThenState exit M₂).step^[a + 1 + k])
        ((M₁.andThenState exit M₂).startCfg T) =
        TypedConfiguration.inRightState st
          (((M₂ st).step^[k]) ((M₂ st).startCfg T')) := by
  have hcfg : (M₁.andThenState exit M₂).startCfg T =
      TypedConfiguration.inLeftState (M₁.startCfg T) := rfl
  constructor
  · rw [hcfg]
    exact HaltsExactly.andThenState hexit hfresh (by rw [hst, htp]; exact h₂)
  · rw [hcfg, TypedMachine.andThenState_iterate M₁ exit M₂ _ a hexit hfresh k,
      hst, htp]
    rfl

/-! ## Carrying the next state out of the chain -/

/-- Halt after one step, with a payload in the state where the loop's `next`
function can read it. -/
def carryQ {Q : Type} (q : Q) : TypedMachine tapes (Option Q) where
  start := none
  transition := fun _ symbols => (some q, fun j => (symbols j, HeadMove.stay))
  result := fun s => match s with
    | some _ => some false
    | none => none

theorem carryQ_run {Q : Type} (q : Q) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    ((carryQ (tapes := tapes) q).step^[1]) ((carryQ q).startCfg tape) =
      ⟨some q, tape⟩ := by
  show (carryQ q).step ((carryQ q).startCfg tape) = _
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, carryQ]
  congr 1


theorem carryQ_spec {Q : Type} (q : Q) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    HaltsExactly (carryQ (tapes := tapes) q) ((carryQ q).startCfg tape) 1
      false := by
  constructor
  · rw [carryQ_run]
    rfl
  · intro j hj
    have : j = 0 := by omega
    subst this
    rfl

/-! ## Peeling the terminal term -/

/-- One `andThen` layer of a terminal state. -/
def peelB {S₁ S₂ : Type} : S₁ ⊕ Bool × S₂ → Option S₂
  | .inr (_, s) => some s
  | .inl _ => none

/-- One `andThenState` layer of a terminal state. -/
def peelS {S₁ S₂ : Type} : S₁ ⊕ S₁ × S₂ → Option S₂
  | .inr (_, s) => some s
  | .inl _ => none

@[simp] theorem peelB_inRight {S₁ S₂ : Type} (b : Bool)
    (c : TypedConfiguration tapes S₂) :
    peelB (S₁ := S₁) (TypedConfiguration.inRight b c).state = some c.state :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem peelS_inRightState {S₁ S₂ : Type} (st : S₁)
    (c : TypedConfiguration tapes S₂) :
    peelS (TypedConfiguration.inRightState st c).state = some c.state := rfl

end SipserGacsLautemann
