    rw [hWp, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_reverse, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
      ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: post) G₇ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc, hret7]
    obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
        Wp.reverse ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) = r :: R' := by
      rw [hWrev]
      cases hx : encodeBlocks mid ++ Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₇) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hx
          simp [Block.toCells] at this
      | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
    rw [hcons,
      show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
        TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
      cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
    have henc : encodeBlocks (mid ++ newCur :: post) =
        encodeBlocks mid ++ (Block.toCells newCur ++ encodeBlocks post) := by
      rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons]
    rw [henc]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i (ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: post) G₇)
    with hT7
  have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
    show Function.update T6 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
    rw [hX7]
  have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
      false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
  -- ===== assemble =====
  have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i allNormWindow T5 _ _ hT5i) htp6
    hP7 htp7
  have hC5 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4) htp5
    hC6.1 hC6.2
  have hC4 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s true) T3 _ _ hT3i)
    htp4 hC5.1 hC5.2
  have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2) htp3
    hC4.1 hC4.2
  have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
  have hC1 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape)
    htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
  refine ⟨_, G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
  have hfin := hC1.2
  rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
  simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin
  exact hfin


theorem AllBlank.drop {G : List TapeSymbol} (hG : AllBlank G) (n : Nat) :
    AllBlank (G.drop n) :=
  fun c hc => hG c (List.mem_of_mem_drop hc)

/-- The region a rightward flag-move produces: the flag lands on the next
block, or on a materialised fresh one at the region's end. -/
def rightResult (side : TrackSide) (mid : List Block) (newCur : Block) :
    List Block → List Block
  | nxt :: post' => mid ++ newCur :: setFlag side true nxt :: post'
  | [] => mid ++ [newCur, freshFlagged side]

/-! ## The right variant -/

theorem updateTrack_right (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes) (s : TapeSymbol)
    (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (mid : List Block) (cur : Block)
    (post : List Block) (G : List TapeSymbol) (hG : AllBlank G)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true)
    (hi : tape i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G) :
    ∃ (cost : Nat) (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' ∧
      HaltsExactly (updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right)
        ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).startCfg tape) cost false ∧
      (((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).step^[cost])
        ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape =
        Function.update tape i
          (ParkedTape
            (rightResult side mid (setSymFlag side s false cur) post) G') := by
  classical
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  set newCur := setSymFlag side s false cur with hnewCur
  -- ===== junctions 1-4: shared skeleton =====
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur post hmid hcur hT1i
  set W1 := loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length + blockReadSteps
    with hW1
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hsplit : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) =
      encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ encodeBlocks post := by
    rw [← encodeBlocks_append]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i, hsplit, List.append_assoc,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp,
      cellsTape_advance]
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃))) with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
      show (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] =
          (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append]
        simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons],
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T3 _ _ hT3i, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_symWindow, ← hnewCur,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  -- ===== junction 5: no movement =====
  have h5 : HaltsExactly (moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left)
      ((moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4) 0 true :=
    moveUpTo_spec i 0 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4
  have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left).step^[0])
      ((moveUpTo i 0 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T4 := rfl
  -- ===== junctions 6-7: split on whether a next block exists =====
  cases post with
  | cons nxt post' =>
      set sNxt := setFlag side true nxt with hsNxt
      have hR4 : T4 i = cellsTape
          ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
          (Block.toCells nxt ++ (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃)) := by
        rw [hT4i, encodeBlocks_cons, List.append_assoc]
      set T6 := Function.update T4 i
        (cellsTape ((Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
            ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
              ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])))
          (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃)) with hT6
      have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).step^[6])
          ((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).startCfg T4)).tape = T6 := by
        rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T4 _ _ hR4, hT6]
        congr 1
        rw [patchCellsN_flagWindow, ← hsNxt,
          show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells nxt).length from
            (Block.toCells_length nxt).symm,
          List.drop_left]
      have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
          ((Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
            ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
              ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])))
          (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃) := by
        rw [hT6]; simp
      -- park
      set Wp := (Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ (encodeBlocks mid).reverse)
        with hWp
      have hassoc : (Block.toCells sNxt).reverse ++
          ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])) =
          Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] := by
        rw [hWp]
        simp [List.append_assoc]
      have hWp_nb : ∀ c ∈ Wp, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
        intro c hc
        rw [hWp] at hc
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with h | h
        · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
        · rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h' | h'
          · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h')
          · exact encodeBlocks_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h')
      obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        ((encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃).headD TapeSymbol.blank)
        ((encodeBlocks post' ++ G₃).tail)
      rw [blankIndex_written Wp [] hWp_nb] at hlt' heq'
      have hlt : ∀ k, k < Wp.length →
          ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[k + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠
            TapeSymbol.blank := by
        intro k hk
        rw [hT6i, hassoc]
        exact hlt' k hk
      have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)).head =
          TapeSymbol.blank := by
        rw [hT6i, hassoc]
        exact heq'
      obtain ⟨G₇, hG₇, hret7⟩ := retreat_block Wp [TapeSymbol.blank] post' G₃
        hG₃
      have hWrev : Wp.reverse = encodeBlocks mid ++
          (Block.toCells newCur ++ Block.toCells sNxt) := by
        rw [hWp]
        simp [List.reverse_append]
      have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
          ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: sNxt :: post') G₇ := by
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc, hret7]
        obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
            Wp.reverse ++ (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₇) = r :: R' := by
          rw [hWrev]
          cases hx : encodeBlocks mid ++
              (Block.toCells newCur ++ Block.toCells sNxt) ++
              (encodeBlocks post' ++ G₇) with
          | nil =>
              exfalso
              have := congrArg List.length hx
              simp [Block.toCells] at this
          | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
        rw [hcons,
          show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
            TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
          cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
        have henc : encodeBlocks (mid ++ newCur :: sNxt :: post') =
            encodeBlocks mid ++ (Block.toCells newCur ++
              (Block.toCells sNxt ++ encodeBlocks post')) := by
          rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons, encodeBlocks_cons]
        rw [henc]
        simp [List.append_assoc]
      set T7 := Function.update T6 i
        (ParkedTape (mid ++ newCur :: sNxt :: post') G₇) with hT7
      have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
          ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
        rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
        show Function.update T6 i
          ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
        rw [hX7]
      have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
          ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
          false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
      have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (flagWindow side) T4 _ _ hR4)
        htp6 hP7 htp7
      have hC5 := chainStep h5 htp5 hC6.1 hC6.2
      have hC4 := chainStep
        (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s false) T3 _ _ hT3i) htp4
        hC5.1 hC5.2
      have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
        htp3 hC4.1 hC4.2
      have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
      have hC1 := chainStep
        (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape) htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
      refine ⟨_, G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
      have hfin := hC1.2
      rw [hT7, hT6, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
      simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin
      exact hfin
  | nil =>
      have hR4 : T4 i = cellsTape
          ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])) G₃ := by
        rw [hT4i]
        simp
      set T6 := Function.update T4 i
        (cellsTape ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse ++
            ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
              ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])))
          (G₃.drop 6)) with hT6
      have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).step^[6])
          ((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).startCfg T4)).tape = T6 := by
        rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T4 _ _ hR4, hT6]
        congr 1
        rw [patchCellsN_flagWindow_fresh side G₃ hG₃]
      have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
          ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse ++
            ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
              ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])))
          (G₃.drop 6) := by
        rw [hT6]; simp
      have hG₆ : AllBlank (G₃.drop 6) := hG₃.drop 6
      set Wp := (Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse ++
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ (encodeBlocks mid).reverse)
        with hWp
      have hassoc : (Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse ++
          ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])) =
          Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] := by
        rw [hWp]
        simp [List.append_assoc]
      have hWp_nb : ∀ c ∈ Wp, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
        intro c hc
        rw [hWp] at hc
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with h | h
        · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
        · rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h' | h'
          · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h')
          · exact encodeBlocks_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h')
      obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        ((G₃.drop 6).headD TapeSymbol.blank) ((G₃.drop 6).tail)
      rw [blankIndex_written Wp [] hWp_nb] at hlt' heq'
      have hlt : ∀ k, k < Wp.length →
          ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[k + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠
            TapeSymbol.blank := by
        intro k hk
        rw [hT6i, hassoc]
        exact hlt' k hk
      have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)).head =
          TapeSymbol.blank := by
        rw [hT6i, hassoc]
        exact heq'
      obtain ⟨G₇, hG₇, hret7⟩ := retreat_block Wp [TapeSymbol.blank] []
        (G₃.drop 6) hG₆
      have hWrev : Wp.reverse = encodeBlocks mid ++
          (Block.toCells newCur ++ Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)) := by
        rw [hWp]
        simp [List.reverse_append]
      have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
          ParkedTape (mid ++ [newCur, freshFlagged side]) G₇ := by
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc]
        have hret7' : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length]
            (cellsTape (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) (G₃.drop 6)) =
            cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank] (Wp.reverse ++ G₇) := by
          have h := hret7
          simpa using h
        rw [hret7']
        obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R', Wp.reverse ++ G₇ = r :: R' := by
          rw [hWrev]
          cases hx : encodeBlocks mid ++
              (Block.toCells newCur ++
                Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)) ++ G₇ with
          | nil =>
              exfalso
              have := congrArg List.length hx
              simp [Block.toCells] at this
          | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
        rw [hcons,
          show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
            TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
          cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
        have henc : encodeBlocks (mid ++ [newCur, freshFlagged side]) =
            encodeBlocks mid ++ (Block.toCells newCur ++
              Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)) := by
          rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons, encodeBlocks_cons,
            encodeBlocks_nil, List.append_nil]
        rw [henc]
      set T7 := Function.update T6 i
        (ParkedTape (mid ++ [newCur, freshFlagged side]) G₇) with hT7
      have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
          ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
        rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
        show Function.update T6 i
          ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
        rw [hX7]
      have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
          ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
          false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
      have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (flagWindow side) T4 _ _ hR4)
        htp6 hP7 htp7
      have hC5 := chainStep h5 htp5 hC6.1 hC6.2
      have hC4 := chainStep
        (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s false) T3 _ _ hT3i) htp4
        hC5.1 hC5.2
      have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
        htp3 hC4.1 hC4.2
      have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
      have hC1 := chainStep
        (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape) htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
      refine ⟨_, G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
      have hfin := hC1.2
      rw [hT7, hT6, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1] at hfin
      simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem] at hfin
      exact hfin


/-- The region a leftward flag-move produces: the flag lands on the previous
block, or on a materialised fresh one before the region's start. -/
def leftResult (side : TrackSide) (newCur : Block) (post : List Block)
    (mid : List Block) : List Block :=
  match mid.reverse with
  | [] => freshFlagged side :: newCur :: post
  | prv :: rmid' => rmid'.reverse ++ setFlag side true prv :: newCur :: post

theorem leftResult_nil (side : TrackSide) (newCur : Block)
    (post : List Block) :
    leftResult side newCur post [] =
      freshFlagged side :: newCur :: post := rfl

theorem leftResult_concat (side : TrackSide) (newCur : Block)
    (post : List Block) (mid' : List Block) (prv : Block) :
    leftResult side newCur post (mid' ++ [prv]) =
      mid' ++ setFlag side true prv :: newCur :: post := by
  simp [leftResult]

/-! ## The left variant -/

theorem updateTrack_left (side : TrackSide) (i : Fin tapes) (s : TapeSymbol)
    (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (mid : List Block) (cur : Block)
    (post : List Block) (G : List TapeSymbol) (hG : AllBlank G)
    (hmid : ∀ b ∈ mid, side.getFlag b = false)
    (hcur : side.getFlag cur = true)
    (hi : tape i = ParkedTape (mid ++ cur :: post) G) :
    ∃ (cost : Nat) (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' ∧
      HaltsExactly (updateTrack side i s HeadMove.left)
        ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.left).startCfg tape) cost false ∧
      (((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.left).step^[cost])
        ((updateTrack side i s HeadMove.left).startCfg tape)).tape =
        Function.update tape i
          (ParkedTape
            (leftResult side (setSymFlag side s false cur) post mid) G') := by
  classical
  have hCl : (Block.toCells cur).length = 6 := Block.toCells_length cur
  set newCur := setSymFlag side s false cur with hnewCur
  -- ===== junctions 1-4: shared skeleton =====
  set T1 : Fin tapes → Tape := Function.update tape i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G)) with hT1
  have htp1 : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg tape)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape, hT1]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hi, ParkedTape]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight _ _ _
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT1]; simp
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hwt⟩ := walkToFlag_spec side i T1 [TapeSymbol.blank] G
    mid cur post hmid hcur hT1i
  set W1 := loopCost (fun _ => blockReadSteps) mid.length + blockReadSteps
    with hW1
  set T2 := scanTapesDir T1 i HeadMove.right (6 * (mid.length + 1)) with hT2
  have hsplit : encodeBlocks (mid ++ cur :: post) =
      encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur]) ++ encodeBlocks post := by
    rw [← encodeBlocks_append]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape ((encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2, scanTapesDir_self, hT1i, hsplit, List.append_assoc,
      show 6 * (mid.length + 1) = (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).length by
        rw [encodeBlocks_length]; simp,
      cellsTape_advance]
  obtain ⟨G₃, hG₃, hret3⟩ := retreat_block (Block.toCells cur).reverse
    ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G hG
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃))) with hT3
  have htp3 : (((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).step^[6])
      ((moveUpTo i 6 HeadMove.left).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2, hT3]
    congr 1
    rw [hT2i,
      show (encodeBlocks (mid ++ [cur])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] =
          (Block.toCells cur).reverse ++
            ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append]
        simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons],
      show (6 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells cur).reverse).length by simp [hCl]]
    rw [hret3, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape
      ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (Block.toCells cur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) with hT4
  have htp4 : (((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).step^[6])
      ((patchRun6 i (symWindow side s false)).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T3 _ _ hT3i, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [patchCellsN_symWindow, ← hnewCur,
      show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells cur).length from hCl.symm,
      List.drop_left]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  -- ===== junctions 5-7: split on whether a previous block exists =====
  rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat mid with rfl | ⟨mid', prv, rfl⟩
  · -- mid = []: the flag walks off the left end; the park relocates
    have hT4i' : T4 i = cellsTape
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃) := by
      rw [hT4i]
      simp
    obtain ⟨G₅, hG₅, hret5⟩ := retreat_block
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) [] post G₃ hG₃
    have hret5' : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[7]
        (cellsTape ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₃)) =
        cellsTape [] (TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
      have h7 : (7 : Nat) =
          ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]).length := by
        simp [Block.toCells_length]
      rw [h7]
      have h := hret5
      rw [List.append_nil] at h
      rw [h]
      simp [List.reverse_append]
    have hX5 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[12] (T4 i) =
        cellsTape [] (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
            (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
      rw [hT4i', show (12 : Nat) = 5 + 7 from rfl,
        Function.iterate_add_apply, hret5']
      exact cellsTape_retreat_past 5 TapeSymbol.blank
        (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))
    set T5 := Function.update T4 i
      (cellsTape [] (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT5
    have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 12 HeadMove.left).step^[12])
        ((moveUpTo i 12 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 12 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4, hT5]
      exact congrArg (Function.update T4 i) hX5
    have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape []
        (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
            (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
      rw [hT5]; simp
    -- the six cells ahead are all blank; the flag window materialises
    have hR5eq : List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) =
        List.replicate 6 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
      rw [show List.replicate 6 TapeSymbol.blank =
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] from
          List.replicate_succ' .. ]
      simp [List.append_assoc]
    have hpatch : patchCellsN 6 (flagWindow side)
        (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
            (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) =
        Block.toCells (freshFlagged side) := by
      rw [hR5eq]
      rw [patchCellsN_congr_prefix 6 (flagWindow side) _
        (List.replicate 6 TapeSymbol.blank)
        (by rw [List.take_left' (by simp), List.take_of_length_le (by simp)])]
      exact patchCellsN_flagWindow_fresh side _
        (fun c hc => (List.eq_of_mem_replicate hc))
    have hdrop : (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        TapeSymbol.blank :: Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).drop 6 =
        Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) := by
      rw [hR5eq, List.drop_left' (by simp)]
    set T6 := Function.update T5 i
      (cellsTape ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse)
        (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT6
    have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).step^[6])
        ((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
      rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T5 _ _ hT5i, hT6]
      refine congrArg (Function.update T5 i) ?_
      rw [hpatch, hdrop]
      simp
    have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
        ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse)
        (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
      rw [hT6]; simp
    -- park: six written cells, no blank behind them
    have hW_nb : ∀ c ∈ (Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse,
        c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
      intro c hc
      exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp hc)
    obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec
      ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse)
      ((Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).headD
        TapeSymbol.blank)
      ((Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).tail)
    rw [blankIndex_all _ hW_nb] at hlt' heq'
    have hWl : ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse).length = 6 := by
      simp [Block.toCells_length]
    have hlt : ∀ k, k < 6 →
        ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[k + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠
          TapeSymbol.blank := by
      intro k hk
      rw [hT6i]
      exact hlt' k (by omega)
    have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[6 + 1] (T6 i)).head =
        TapeSymbol.blank := by
      rw [hT6i]
      have h := heq'
      rw [hWl] at h
      exact h
    have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[6 + 1] (T6 i) =
        ParkedTape (freshFlagged side :: newCur :: post) G₅ := by
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i]
      obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
          Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) = r :: R' := by
        cases hx : Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) with
        | nil =>
            exfalso
            have := congrArg List.length hx
            simp [Block.toCells] at this
        | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
      rw [hcons, show (6 : Nat) =
          ((Block.toCells (freshFlagged side)).reverse).length from hWl.symm]
      rw [cellsTape_retreat_nilL, List.reverse_reverse, ← hcons]
      obtain ⟨r₂, R₂, hcons₂⟩ : ∃ r₂ R₂,
          Block.toCells (freshFlagged side) ++
            (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) =
            r₂ :: R₂ := by
        cases hx : Block.toCells (freshFlagged side) ++
            (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) with
        | nil =>
            exfalso
            have := congrArg List.length hx
            simp [Block.toCells] at this
        | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
      rw [hcons₂, cellsTape_moveLeft_nilL, ← hcons₂, ParkedTape]
      simp [encodeBlocks_cons, List.append_assoc]
    set T7 := Function.update T6 i
      (ParkedTape (freshFlagged side :: newCur :: post) G₅) with hT7
    have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[6 * 4 + 3])
        ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
      rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 6 hlt heq, hT7]
      show Function.update T6 i
        ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[6 + 1] (T6 i)) = _
      rw [hX7]
    have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
        ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (6 * 4 + 3) false :=
      scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 6 hlt heq
    have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (flagWindow side) T5 _ _ hT5i)
      htp6 hP7 htp7
    have hC5 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 12 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4)
      htp5 hC6.1 hC6.2
    have hC4 := chainStep
      (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s false) T3 _ _ hT3i) htp4
      hC5.1 hC5.2
    have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
      htp3 hC4.1 hC4.2
    have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
    have hC1 := chainStep
      (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape) htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
    have hT7flat : T7 = Function.update tape i
        (ParkedTape (freshFlagged side :: newCur :: post) G₅) := by
      rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1]
      simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem]
    refine ⟨_, G₅, hG₅, hC1.1, ?_⟩
    rw [leftResult_nil]
    exact hC1.2.trans hT7flat
  · -- mid = mid' ++ [prv]: the flag lands on the previous block
    simp only [List.concat_eq_append] at *
    set sPrv := setFlag side true prv with hsPrv
    have hL4 : (Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks (mid' ++ [prv])).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) =
        ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ (Block.toCells prv).reverse) ++
          ((encodeBlocks mid').reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) := by
      rw [encodeBlocks_append]
      simp [List.reverse_append, encodeBlocks_cons, List.append_assoc]
    obtain ⟨G₅, hG₅, hret5⟩ := retreat_block
      ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++ (Block.toCells prv).reverse)
      ((encodeBlocks mid').reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) post G₃ hG₃
    set T5 := Function.update T4 i
      (cellsTape ((encodeBlocks mid').reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (Block.toCells prv ++ (Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)))) with hT5
    have htp5 : (((moveUpTo i 12 HeadMove.left).step^[12])
        ((moveUpTo i 12 HeadMove.left).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 12 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4, hT5]
      refine congrArg (Function.update T4 i) ?_
      rw [hT4i, hL4,
        show (12 : Nat) = ((Block.toCells newCur).reverse ++
          (Block.toCells prv).reverse).length by
            simp [Block.toCells_length]]
      rw [hret5]
      simp [List.reverse_append, List.append_assoc]
    have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape
        ((encodeBlocks mid').reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
        (Block.toCells prv ++ (Block.toCells newCur ++
          (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) := by
      rw [hT5]; simp
    set T6 := Function.update T5 i
      (cellsTape ((Block.toCells sPrv).reverse ++
          ((encodeBlocks mid').reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
        (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅))) with hT6
    have htp6 : (((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).step^[6])
        ((patchRun6 i (flagWindow side)).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
      rw [patchRun6_tape i _ T5 _ _ hT5i, hT6]
      refine congrArg (Function.update T5 i) ?_
      rw [patchCellsN_flagWindow, ← hsPrv,
        show (6 : Nat) = (Block.toCells prv).length from
          (Block.toCells_length prv).symm,
        List.drop_left]
    have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
        ((Block.toCells sPrv).reverse ++
          ((encodeBlocks mid').reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
        (Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)) := by
      rw [hT6]; simp
    -- park
    set Wp := (Block.toCells sPrv).reverse ++ (encodeBlocks mid').reverse
      with hWp
    have hassoc : (Block.toCells sPrv).reverse ++
        ((encodeBlocks mid').reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) =
        Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] := by
      rw [hWp, List.append_assoc]
    have hWp_nb : ∀ c ∈ Wp, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
      intro c hc
      rw [hWp] at hc
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with h | h
      · exact Block.toCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
      · exact encodeBlocks_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
    obtain ⟨hlt', heq'⟩ := blank_scan_left_spec (Wp ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      ((Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).headD
        TapeSymbol.blank)
      ((Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅)).tail)
    rw [blankIndex_written Wp [] hWp_nb] at hlt' heq'
    have hlt : ∀ k, k < Wp.length →
        ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[k + 1] (T6 i)).head ≠
          TapeSymbol.blank := by
      intro k hk
      rw [hT6i, hassoc]
      exact hlt' k hk
    have heq : ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)).head =
        TapeSymbol.blank := by
      rw [hT6i, hassoc]
      exact heq'
    have hR6 : Block.toCells newCur ++ (encodeBlocks post ++ G₅) =
        encodeBlocks (newCur :: post) ++ G₅ := by
      rw [encodeBlocks_cons]
      simp [List.append_assoc]
    obtain ⟨G₇, hG₇, hret7⟩ := retreat_block Wp [TapeSymbol.blank]
      (newCur :: post) G₅ hG₅
    have hWrev : Wp.reverse = encodeBlocks mid' ++ Block.toCells sPrv := by
      rw [hWp, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_reverse,
        List.reverse_reverse]
    have hX7 : (moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i) =
        ParkedTape (mid' ++ sPrv :: newCur :: post) G₇ := by
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hT6i, hassoc, hR6, hret7]
      obtain ⟨r, R', hcons⟩ : ∃ r R',
          Wp.reverse ++ (encodeBlocks (newCur :: post) ++ G₇) = r :: R' := by
        rw [hWrev]
        cases hx : encodeBlocks mid' ++ Block.toCells sPrv ++
            (encodeBlocks (newCur :: post) ++ G₇) with
        | nil =>
            exfalso
            have := congrArg List.length hx
            simp [Block.toCells] at this
        | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as, rfl⟩
      rw [hcons,
        show ([TapeSymbol.blank] : List TapeSymbol) =
          TapeSymbol.blank :: [] from rfl,
        cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons, hWrev, ParkedTape]
      have henc : encodeBlocks (mid' ++ sPrv :: newCur :: post) =
          encodeBlocks mid' ++ (Block.toCells sPrv ++
            encodeBlocks (newCur :: post)) := by
        rw [encodeBlocks_append, encodeBlocks_cons]
      rw [henc]
      simp [List.append_assoc]
    set T7 := Function.update T6 i
      (ParkedTape (mid' ++ sPrv :: newCur :: post) G₇) with hT7
    have htp7 : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).step^[Wp.length * 4 + 3])
        ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
      rw [scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq, hT7]
      show Function.update T6 i
        ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[Wp.length + 1] (T6 i)) = _
      rw [hX7]
    have hP7 : HaltsExactly (scanToBlank i HeadMove.left)
        ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.left).startCfg T6) (Wp.length * 4 + 3)
        false := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.left T6 Wp.length hlt heq
    have hC6 := chainStep (patchRun6_spec i (flagWindow side) T5 _ _ hT5i)
      htp6 hP7 htp7
    have hC5 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 12 HeadMove.left (by omega) T4)
      htp5 hC6.1 hC6.2
    have hC4 := chainStep
      (patchRun6_spec i (symWindow side s false) T3 _ _ hT3i) htp4
      hC5.1 hC5.2
    have hC3 := chainStep (moveUpTo_spec i 6 HeadMove.left (by omega) T2)
      htp3 hC4.1 hC4.2
    have hC2 := chainStep hw hwt hC3.1 hC3.2
    have hC1 := chainStep
      (moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) tape) htp1 hC2.1 hC2.2
    have hT7flat : T7 = Function.update tape i
        (ParkedTape (mid' ++ sPrv :: newCur :: post) G₇) := by
      rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1]
      simp only [scanTapesDir, Function.update_idem]
    refine ⟨_, G₇, hG₇, hC1.1, ?_⟩
    rw [leftResult_concat]
    exact hC1.2.trans hT7flat

end SipserGacsLautemann
theorems.natural_language_statement:
The track update, complete: module D's summit.

`updateTrack side i s mv` performs one full surgical update on a hosted track: from the parked position, walk to the flagged block, write symbol $s$ there, move the track's head-flag per $mv$, and return to the parked position. Its three specifications — `updateTrack_stay`, `updateTrack_right`, `updateTrack_left` — each give an exact halting time and the exact final tapes:

$$
\mathrm{tape}' \;=\; \mathrm{update}\ \mathrm{tape}\ i\ \big(\mathrm{ParkedTape}\ (\mathit{newBlocks})\ G'\big),
$$

where `newBlocks` rewrites the flagged block and relocates the flag — onto the same block, the next (materialising a fresh block at the right edge), or the previous (materialising one before the region's start, which relocates the park itself). The ghost parameter $G$ — all-blank residue beyond the region from earlier excursions — is carried through every specification, growing as the head explores.

**One machine, all cases.** The variants differ only in data — window contents and retreat distances — never in shape, so the state type is independent of `side` and `mv` and the simulation can dispatch on runtime data without type trouble. There is no runtime edge test anywhere: the normalising window materialises a fresh block by exactly the six operations that leave an existing one intact.

**Proof structure.** Each specification is a chain of seven junctions — enter, walk, retreat, symbol window, reposition, flag window, park — composed by `chainStep`, which propagates a piece's halt and final tapes through `andThen` in one application. The junction tapes are explicit `cellsTape` values; the only case analyses are the genuine ones (does a neighbouring block exist), handled as list-shape splits in the *proof*, never as tests in the *machine*.

With this module the low-level plumbing for `merge_empty_scratch_tapes` is complete: what remains is the simulation invariant and the per-step program (module E), which consume these specifications without touching `step` or `run` again.
theorems.source: Standard track-surgery simulation for multitape Turing machines, specialized to the model of Def_sipser_gacs_lautemann; builds on Def_sgl_patch_run.
theorems.theorem_title: The track update: write and flag-move, fully specified

theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_region_update

/-!
# Patch runs

Module D, fourth part: the machinery that makes the update variants uniform.

The update must sometimes write into a neighbouring block that *does not exist
yet* — the flag walks off the region's edge and a fresh block must materialise.
Testing for the edge at runtime would split every variant in two and force the
two branches into one state type.  The escape is that **a normalising write
pass is edge-oblivious**: writing `normalize(cell)` — blank becomes the written
zero-code, anything written stays itself — while moving preserves an existing
block exactly and builds a fresh blank-symbol block out of raw tape.  Setting a
flag in a neighbour is then the same six-cell pass whether or not the
neighbour exists, with a single `put` at the flag's offset.

Two machines and a lemma:

* `patchRun6` — a six-cell pass of `norm`/`put` operations, as one counter
  machine over the *fixed* state `Fin 7`, so every window has the same type and
  the simulation can dispatch on runtime data without type trouble.
* `moveUpTo` — head movement over the fixed state `Fin 13`, same reason.
* `scanToBlank_tape_of` — the final tapes of the parking scan, which the
  navigation module's specification omitted.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-! ## Composition with tape tracking -/

/-- `HaltsExactly.andThen` plus the composite's final tapes, in one step.  The
chained update proofs apply this once per junction. -/
theorem HaltsExactly.andThen_full {S₁ S₂ : Type} {M₁ : TypedMachine tapes S₁}
    {M₂ : Bool → TypedMachine tapes S₂} {c : TypedConfiguration tapes S₁}
    {a : Nat} {b : Bool} {k : Nat} {v : Bool}
    (h₁ : HaltsExactly M₁ c a b)
    (h₂ : HaltsExactly (M₂ b) ((M₂ b).startCfg ((M₁.step^[a]) c).tape) k v) :
    HaltsExactly (M₁.andThen M₂) (TypedConfiguration.inLeft c) (a + 1 + k) v ∧
      (((M₁.andThen M₂).step^[a + 1 + k]) (TypedConfiguration.inLeft c)).tape =
        (((M₂ b).step^[k])
          ((M₂ b).startCfg ((M₁.step^[a]) c).tape)).tape := by
  refine ⟨HaltsExactly.andThen h₁ h₂, ?_⟩
  rw [TypedMachine.andThen_iterate M₁ M₂ c a b h₁.halts h₁.fresh k]
  rfl

/-! ## Patch operations -/

/-- Blank becomes the written zero-code; written cells stay themselves. -/
def normalizeSym : TapeSymbol → TapeSymbol
  | TapeSymbol.blank => TapeSymbol.bit false
  | c => c

@[simp] theorem normalizeSym_bit (b : Bool) :
    normalizeSym (TapeSymbol.bit b) = TapeSymbol.bit b := rfl

@[simp] theorem normalizeSym_blank :
    normalizeSym TapeSymbol.blank = TapeSymbol.bit false := rfl

theorem normalizeSym_of_ne_blank {c : TapeSymbol} (h : c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank) :
    normalizeSym c = c := by
  cases c with
  | blank => exact absurd rfl h
  | bit b => rfl

/-- One cell of an update window: keep-but-normalise, or overwrite. -/
inductive PatchOp where
  | norm
  | put (c : TapeSymbol)

def opValue : PatchOp → TapeSymbol → TapeSymbol
  | .norm, c => normalizeSym c
  | .put c, _ => c

/-- The cells a patch pass writes: driven by the pass length, reading the ops
and the tape cells with blank-padding on both. -/
def patchCellsN : Nat → List PatchOp → List TapeSymbol → List TapeSymbol
  | 0, _, _ => []
  | n + 1, ops, R =>
      opValue (ops.headD .norm) (R.headD TapeSymbol.blank) ::
        patchCellsN n ops.tail R.tail

@[simp] theorem patchCellsN_zero (ops : List PatchOp) (R : List TapeSymbol) :
    patchCellsN 0 ops R = [] := rfl

@[simp] theorem patchCellsN_succ (n : Nat) (ops : List PatchOp)
    (R : List TapeSymbol) :
    patchCellsN (n + 1) ops R =
      opValue (ops.headD .norm) (R.headD TapeSymbol.blank) ::
        patchCellsN n ops.tail R.tail := rfl

theorem patchCellsN_length (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (ops : List PatchOp) (R : List TapeSymbol),
      (patchCellsN n ops R).length = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro ops R; rfl
  | succ n ih => intro ops R; simp [patchCellsN, ih]

/-- Peeling one written cell off the end of a pass. -/
theorem patchCellsN_succ_append (m : Nat) :
    ∀ (ops : List PatchOp) (R : List TapeSymbol),
      patchCellsN (m + 1) ops R =
        patchCellsN m ops R ++
          [opValue (ops.getD m .norm) ((R.drop m).headD TapeSymbol.blank)] := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      intro ops R
      simp [patchCellsN]
      cases ops <;> rfl
  | succ m ih =>
      intro ops R
      rw [patchCellsN_succ, ih ops.tail R.tail, patchCellsN_succ,
        List.cons_append]
      have h1 : ops.tail.getD m PatchOp.norm = ops.getD (m + 1) PatchOp.norm := by
        cases ops <;> rfl
      have h2 : R.tail.drop m = R.drop (m + 1) := by
        cases R <;> simp
      rw [h1, h2]

/-! ## The patch machine -/

/-- A six-cell patch pass under head `i`, moving right.  The state is the fixed
`Fin 7` regardless of `ops`, so windows with different contents share one
type. -/
def patchRun6 (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp) :
    TypedMachine tapes (Fin 7) where
  start := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  transition := fun s symbols =>
    if h : s.val < 6 then
      (⟨s.val + 1, by omega⟩,
        fun j =>
          (if j = i then opValue (ops.getD s.val .norm) (symbols i)
            else symbols j,
            if j = i then HeadMove.right else HeadMove.stay))
    else (s, fun j => (symbols j, HeadMove.stay))
  result := fun s => if s.val = 6 then some true else none

theorem patchRun6_step (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp)
    (m : Nat) (hm : m < 6) (t : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    (patchRun6 i ops).step ⟨⟨m, by omega⟩, t⟩ =
      ⟨⟨m + 1, by omega⟩,
        Function.update t i
          (Tape.move
            (Tape.write (t i) (opValue (ops.getD m .norm) (t i).head))
            HeadMove.right)⟩ := by
  have hres : (patchRun6 i ops).result ⟨m, by omega⟩ = none := by
    simp [patchRun6]
    omega
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [patchRun6, dif_pos hm]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp
  · simp [hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem patchRun6_run (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp) (m : Nat)
    (hm : m ≤ 6) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (L R : List TapeSymbol)
    (hi : tape i = cellsTape L R) :
    ((patchRun6 i ops).step^[m]) ((patchRun6 i ops).startCfg tape) =
      ⟨⟨m, by omega⟩,
        Function.update tape i
          (cellsTape ((patchCellsN m ops R).reverse ++ L) (R.drop m))⟩ := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, patchCellsN_zero,
        List.drop_zero, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, ← hi,
        Function.update_eq_self]
      rfl
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih (by omega),
        patchRun6_step i ops m (by omega)]
      congr 1
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp only [Function.update_self]
        have hhead : (cellsTape ((patchCellsN m ops R).reverse ++ L)
            (R.drop m)).head = (R.drop m).headD TapeSymbol.blank := rfl
        rw [hhead, cellsTape_writeMove, patchCellsN_succ_append,
          List.reverse_append, List.tail_drop]
        simp
      · simp [hj]

theorem patchRun6_spec (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp)
    (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (L R : List TapeSymbol)
    (hi : tape i = cellsTape L R) :
    HaltsExactly (patchRun6 i ops) ((patchRun6 i ops).startCfg tape) 6
      true := by
  constructor
  · rw [patchRun6_run i ops 6 (by omega) tape L R hi]
    simp [patchRun6]
  · intro j hj
    rw [patchRun6_run i ops j (by omega) tape L R hi]
    simp [patchRun6]
    omega

theorem patchRun6_tape (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp)
    (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (L R : List TapeSymbol)
    (hi : tape i = cellsTape L R) :
    (((patchRun6 i ops).step^[6]) ((patchRun6 i ops).startCfg tape)).tape =
      Function.update tape i
        (cellsTape ((patchCellsN 6 ops R).reverse ++ L) (R.drop 6)) := by
  rw [patchRun6_run i ops 6 (by omega) tape L R hi]

/-! ## Bounded movement -/

/-- Move head `i` exactly `k ≤ 12` cells in direction `dir`, over the fixed
state `Fin 13`, so movers of different distances share one type. -/
def moveUpTo (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove) :
    TypedMachine tapes (Fin 13) where
  start := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  transition := fun s symbols =>
    if h : s.val < min k 12 then
      (⟨s.val + 1, by omega⟩,
        fun j => (symbols j, if j = i then dir else HeadMove.stay))
    else (s, fun j => (symbols j, HeadMove.stay))
  result := fun s => if s.val = min k 12 then some true else none

theorem moveUpTo_step (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove)
    (m : Nat) (hm : m < min k 12) (t : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    (moveUpTo i k dir).step ⟨⟨m, by omega⟩, t⟩ =
      ⟨⟨m + 1, by omega⟩, Function.update t i (moveDir dir (t i))⟩ := by
  have hres : (moveUpTo i k dir).result ⟨m, by omega⟩ = none := by
    simp [moveUpTo]
    omega
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [moveUpTo, dif_pos hm]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [moveDir, Tape.write_head_self]
  · simp [hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem moveUpTo_run (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove) (m : Nat)
    (hm : m ≤ min k 12) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    ((moveUpTo i k dir).step^[m]) ((moveUpTo i k dir).startCfg tape) =
      ⟨⟨m, by omega⟩,
        Function.update tape i ((moveDir dir)^[m] (tape i))⟩ := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Function.iterate_zero, id_eq,
        Function.update_eq_self]
      rfl
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih (by omega),
        moveUpTo_step i k dir m (by omega)]
      congr 1
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      · simp [hj]

theorem moveUpTo_spec (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove)
    (hk : k ≤ 12) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    HaltsExactly (moveUpTo i k dir) ((moveUpTo i k dir).startCfg tape) k
      true := by
  have hmin : min k 12 = k := by omega
  constructor
  · rw [moveUpTo_run i k dir k (by omega) tape]
    simp [moveUpTo, hmin]
  · intro j hj
    rw [moveUpTo_run i k dir j (by omega) tape]
    simp [moveUpTo, hmin]
    omega

theorem moveUpTo_tape (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove)
    (hk : k ≤ 12) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    (((moveUpTo i k dir).step^[k]) ((moveUpTo i k dir).startCfg tape)).tape =
      Function.update tape i ((moveDir dir)^[k] (tape i)) := by
  rw [moveUpTo_run i k dir k (by omega) tape]

/-! ## The parking scan's final tapes -/

/-- `blankIndex` of a written run followed by a blank. -/
theorem blankIndex_written (W T : List TapeSymbol)
    (hW : ∀ c ∈ W, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank) :
    blankIndex (W ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: T) = W.length := by
  induction W with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      cases hc : c with
      | blank =>
          exact absurd hc (hW c (List.mem_cons_self))
      | bit b =>
          simp only [List.cons_append, blankIndex, List.length_cons]
          rw [ih (fun x hx => hW x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))]

/-- The tapes the parking scan leaves behind — the navigation module's
specification gives the halt but not the tapes, so this reconstructs the loop
rounds and projects. -/
theorem scanToBlank_tape_of (i : Fin tapes) (dir : HeadMove)
    (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (d : Nat)
    (hlt : ∀ k, k < d →
      ((moveDir dir)^[k + 1] (tape i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank)
    (heq : ((moveDir dir)^[d + 1] (tape i)).head = TapeSymbol.blank) :
    (((scanToBlank i dir).step^[d * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i dir).startCfg tape)).tape =
      scanTapesDir tape i dir (d + 1) := by
  have hround : ∀ m, m < d →
      HaltsExactly (scanBody i dir)
          ((scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir m))
          (1 + 1 + 1) true ∧
        (scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir (m + 1)) =
          ⟨(scanBody i dir).start,
            (((scanBody i dir).step^[1 + 1 + 1])
              ((scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir m))).tape⟩ := by
    intro m hm
    constructor
    · have h := scanBody_round i dir tape m
      rwa [notBlankAt_true i (scanTapesDir tape i dir (m + 1))
        (by rw [scanTapesDir_head]; exact hlt m hm)] at h
    · rw [scanBody_round_tape]
      rfl
  have hexit : HaltsExactly (scanBody i dir)
      ((scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir d)) (1 + 1 + 1)
      false := by
    have h := scanBody_round i dir tape d
    rwa [notBlankAt_false i (scanTapesDir tape i dir (d + 1))
      (by rw [scanTapesDir_head]; exact heq)] at h
  have htape := TypedMachine.repeatUntilFalse_tape (scanBody i dir)
    (fun m => (scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir m))
    (fun _ => 1 + 1 + 1) d (1 + 1 + 1) hround hexit
  rw [scanBody_round_tape] at htape
  have hcost : loopCost (fun _ => 1 + 1 + 1) d + (1 + 1 + 1) = d * 4 + 3 := by
    rw [loopCost_const]
  rw [← hcost]
  show ((((scanBody i dir).repeatUntilFalse).step^[
      loopCost (fun _ => 1 + 1 + 1) d + (1 + 1 + 1)])
    ((scanToBlank i dir).startCfg tape)).tape = _
  have hcfg0 : (scanToBlank i dir).startCfg tape =
      (scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir 0) := by
    rw [scanTapesDir_zero]
    rfl
  rw [hcfg0]
  exact htape

end SipserGacsLautemann

theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_region_update

/-!
# Patch runs

Module D, fourth part: the machinery that makes the update variants uniform.

The update must sometimes write into a neighbouring block that *does not exist
yet* — the flag walks off the region's edge and a fresh block must materialise.
Testing for the edge at runtime would split every variant in two and force the
two branches into one state type.  The escape is that **a normalising write
pass is edge-oblivious**: writing `normalize(cell)` — blank becomes the written
zero-code, anything written stays itself — while moving preserves an existing
block exactly and builds a fresh blank-symbol block out of raw tape.  Setting a
flag in a neighbour is then the same six-cell pass whether or not the
neighbour exists, with a single `put` at the flag's offset.

Two machines and a lemma:

* `patchRun6` — a six-cell pass of `norm`/`put` operations, as one counter
  machine over the *fixed* state `Fin 7`, so every window has the same type and
  the simulation can dispatch on runtime data without type trouble.
* `moveUpTo` — head movement over the fixed state `Fin 13`, same reason.
* `scanToBlank_tape_of` — the final tapes of the parking scan, which the
  navigation module's specification omitted.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-! ## Composition with tape tracking -/

/-- `HaltsExactly.andThen` plus the composite's final tapes, in one step.  The
chained update proofs apply this once per junction. -/
theorem HaltsExactly.andThen_full {S₁ S₂ : Type} {M₁ : TypedMachine tapes S₁}
    {M₂ : Bool → TypedMachine tapes S₂} {c : TypedConfiguration tapes S₁}
    {a : Nat} {b : Bool} {k : Nat} {v : Bool}
    (h₁ : HaltsExactly M₁ c a b)
    (h₂ : HaltsExactly (M₂ b) ((M₂ b).startCfg ((M₁.step^[a]) c).tape) k v) :
    HaltsExactly (M₁.andThen M₂) (TypedConfiguration.inLeft c) (a + 1 + k) v ∧
      (((M₁.andThen M₂).step^[a + 1 + k]) (TypedConfiguration.inLeft c)).tape =
        (((M₂ b).step^[k])
          ((M₂ b).startCfg ((M₁.step^[a]) c).tape)).tape := by
  refine ⟨HaltsExactly.andThen h₁ h₂, ?_⟩
  rw [TypedMachine.andThen_iterate M₁ M₂ c a b h₁.halts h₁.fresh k]
  rfl

/-! ## Patch operations -/

/-- Blank becomes the written zero-code; written cells stay themselves. -/
def normalizeSym : TapeSymbol → TapeSymbol
  | TapeSymbol.blank => TapeSymbol.bit false
  | c => c

@[simp] theorem normalizeSym_bit (b : Bool) :
    normalizeSym (TapeSymbol.bit b) = TapeSymbol.bit b := rfl

@[simp] theorem normalizeSym_blank :
    normalizeSym TapeSymbol.blank = TapeSymbol.bit false := rfl

theorem normalizeSym_of_ne_blank {c : TapeSymbol} (h : c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank) :
    normalizeSym c = c := by
  cases c with
  | blank => exact absurd rfl h
  | bit b => rfl

/-- One cell of an update window: keep-but-normalise, or overwrite. -/
inductive PatchOp where
  | norm
  | put (c : TapeSymbol)

def opValue : PatchOp → TapeSymbol → TapeSymbol
  | .norm, c => normalizeSym c
  | .put c, _ => c

/-- The cells a patch pass writes: driven by the pass length, reading the ops
and the tape cells with blank-padding on both. -/
def patchCellsN : Nat → List PatchOp → List TapeSymbol → List TapeSymbol
  | 0, _, _ => []
  | n + 1, ops, R =>
      opValue (ops.headD .norm) (R.headD TapeSymbol.blank) ::
        patchCellsN n ops.tail R.tail

@[simp] theorem patchCellsN_zero (ops : List PatchOp) (R : List TapeSymbol) :
    patchCellsN 0 ops R = [] := rfl

@[simp] theorem patchCellsN_succ (n : Nat) (ops : List PatchOp)
    (R : List TapeSymbol) :
    patchCellsN (n + 1) ops R =
      opValue (ops.headD .norm) (R.headD TapeSymbol.blank) ::
        patchCellsN n ops.tail R.tail := rfl

theorem patchCellsN_length (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (ops : List PatchOp) (R : List TapeSymbol),
      (patchCellsN n ops R).length = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro ops R; rfl
  | succ n ih => intro ops R; simp [patchCellsN, ih]

/-- Peeling one written cell off the end of a pass. -/
theorem patchCellsN_succ_append (m : Nat) :
    ∀ (ops : List PatchOp) (R : List TapeSymbol),
      patchCellsN (m + 1) ops R =
        patchCellsN m ops R ++
          [opValue (ops.getD m .norm) ((R.drop m).headD TapeSymbol.blank)] := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      intro ops R
      simp [patchCellsN]
      cases ops <;> rfl
  | succ m ih =>
      intro ops R
      rw [patchCellsN_succ, ih ops.tail R.tail, patchCellsN_succ,
        List.cons_append]
      have h1 : ops.tail.getD m PatchOp.norm = ops.getD (m + 1) PatchOp.norm := by
        cases ops <;> rfl
      have h2 : R.tail.drop m = R.drop (m + 1) := by
        cases R <;> simp
      rw [h1, h2]

/-! ## The patch machine -/

/-- A six-cell patch pass under head `i`, moving right.  The state is the fixed
`Fin 7` regardless of `ops`, so windows with different contents share one
type. -/
def patchRun6 (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp) :
    TypedMachine tapes (Fin 7) where
  start := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  transition := fun s symbols =>
    if h : s.val < 6 then
      (⟨s.val + 1, by omega⟩,
        fun j =>
          (if j = i then opValue (ops.getD s.val .norm) (symbols i)
            else symbols j,
            if j = i then HeadMove.right else HeadMove.stay))
    else (s, fun j => (symbols j, HeadMove.stay))
  result := fun s => if s.val = 6 then some true else none

theorem patchRun6_step (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp)
    (m : Nat) (hm : m < 6) (t : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    (patchRun6 i ops).step ⟨⟨m, by omega⟩, t⟩ =
      ⟨⟨m + 1, by omega⟩,
        Function.update t i
          (Tape.move
            (Tape.write (t i) (opValue (ops.getD m .norm) (t i).head))
            HeadMove.right)⟩ := by
  have hres : (patchRun6 i ops).result ⟨m, by omega⟩ = none := by
    simp [patchRun6]
    omega
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [patchRun6, dif_pos hm]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp
  · simp [hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem patchRun6_run (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp) (m : Nat)
    (hm : m ≤ 6) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (L R : List TapeSymbol)
    (hi : tape i = cellsTape L R) :
    ((patchRun6 i ops).step^[m]) ((patchRun6 i ops).startCfg tape) =
      ⟨⟨m, by omega⟩,
        Function.update tape i
          (cellsTape ((patchCellsN m ops R).reverse ++ L) (R.drop m))⟩ := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, patchCellsN_zero,
        List.drop_zero, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, ← hi,
        Function.update_eq_self]
      rfl
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih (by omega),
        patchRun6_step i ops m (by omega)]
      congr 1
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp only [Function.update_self]
        have hhead : (cellsTape ((patchCellsN m ops R).reverse ++ L)
            (R.drop m)).head = (R.drop m).headD TapeSymbol.blank := rfl
        rw [hhead, cellsTape_writeMove, patchCellsN_succ_append,
          List.reverse_append, List.tail_drop]
        simp
      · simp [hj]

theorem patchRun6_spec (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp)
    (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (L R : List TapeSymbol)
    (hi : tape i = cellsTape L R) :
    HaltsExactly (patchRun6 i ops) ((patchRun6 i ops).startCfg tape) 6
      true := by
  constructor
  · rw [patchRun6_run i ops 6 (by omega) tape L R hi]
    simp [patchRun6]
  · intro j hj
    rw [patchRun6_run i ops j (by omega) tape L R hi]
    simp [patchRun6]
    omega

theorem patchRun6_tape (i : Fin tapes) (ops : List PatchOp)
    (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (L R : List TapeSymbol)
    (hi : tape i = cellsTape L R) :
    (((patchRun6 i ops).step^[6]) ((patchRun6 i ops).startCfg tape)).tape =
      Function.update tape i
        (cellsTape ((patchCellsN 6 ops R).reverse ++ L) (R.drop 6)) := by
  rw [patchRun6_run i ops 6 (by omega) tape L R hi]

/-! ## Bounded movement -/

/-- Move head `i` exactly `k ≤ 12` cells in direction `dir`, over the fixed
state `Fin 13`, so movers of different distances share one type. -/
def moveUpTo (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove) :
    TypedMachine tapes (Fin 13) where
  start := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  transition := fun s symbols =>
    if h : s.val < min k 12 then
      (⟨s.val + 1, by omega⟩,
        fun j => (symbols j, if j = i then dir else HeadMove.stay))
    else (s, fun j => (symbols j, HeadMove.stay))
  result := fun s => if s.val = min k 12 then some true else none

theorem moveUpTo_step (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove)
    (m : Nat) (hm : m < min k 12) (t : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    (moveUpTo i k dir).step ⟨⟨m, by omega⟩, t⟩ =
      ⟨⟨m + 1, by omega⟩, Function.update t i (moveDir dir (t i))⟩ := by
  have hres : (moveUpTo i k dir).result ⟨m, by omega⟩ = none := by
    simp [moveUpTo]
    omega
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [moveUpTo, dif_pos hm]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [moveDir, Tape.write_head_self]
  · simp [hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem moveUpTo_run (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove) (m : Nat)
    (hm : m ≤ min k 12) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    ((moveUpTo i k dir).step^[m]) ((moveUpTo i k dir).startCfg tape) =
      ⟨⟨m, by omega⟩,
        Function.update tape i ((moveDir dir)^[m] (tape i))⟩ := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Function.iterate_zero, id_eq,
        Function.update_eq_self]
      rfl
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih (by omega),
        moveUpTo_step i k dir m (by omega)]
      congr 1
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      · simp [hj]

theorem moveUpTo_spec (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove)
    (hk : k ≤ 12) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    HaltsExactly (moveUpTo i k dir) ((moveUpTo i k dir).startCfg tape) k
      true := by
  have hmin : min k 12 = k := by omega
  constructor
  · rw [moveUpTo_run i k dir k (by omega) tape]
    simp [moveUpTo, hmin]
  · intro j hj
    rw [moveUpTo_run i k dir j (by omega) tape]
    simp [moveUpTo, hmin]
    omega

theorem moveUpTo_tape (i : Fin tapes) (k : Nat) (dir : HeadMove)
    (hk : k ≤ 12) (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    (((moveUpTo i k dir).step^[k]) ((moveUpTo i k dir).startCfg tape)).tape =
      Function.update tape i ((moveDir dir)^[k] (tape i)) := by
  rw [moveUpTo_run i k dir k (by omega) tape]

/-! ## The parking scan's final tapes -/

/-- `blankIndex` of a written run followed by a blank. -/
theorem blankIndex_written (W T : List TapeSymbol)
    (hW : ∀ c ∈ W, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank) :
    blankIndex (W ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: T) = W.length := by
  induction W with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      cases hc : c with
      | blank =>
          exact absurd hc (hW c (List.mem_cons_self))
      | bit b =>
          simp only [List.cons_append, blankIndex, List.length_cons]
          rw [ih (fun x hx => hW x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))]

/-- The tapes the parking scan leaves behind — the navigation module's
specification gives the halt but not the tapes, so this reconstructs the loop
rounds and projects. -/
theorem scanToBlank_tape_of (i : Fin tapes) (dir : HeadMove)
    (tape : Fin tapes → Tape) (d : Nat)
    (hlt : ∀ k, k < d →
      ((moveDir dir)^[k + 1] (tape i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank)
    (heq : ((moveDir dir)^[d + 1] (tape i)).head = TapeSymbol.blank) :
    (((scanToBlank i dir).step^[d * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i dir).startCfg tape)).tape =
      scanTapesDir tape i dir (d + 1) := by
  have hround : ∀ m, m < d →
      HaltsExactly (scanBody i dir)
          ((scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir m))
          (1 + 1 + 1) true ∧
        (scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir (m + 1)) =
          ⟨(scanBody i dir).start,
            (((scanBody i dir).step^[1 + 1 + 1])
              ((scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir m))).tape⟩ := by
    intro m hm
    constructor
    · have h := scanBody_round i dir tape m
      rwa [notBlankAt_true i (scanTapesDir tape i dir (m + 1))
        (by rw [scanTapesDir_head]; exact hlt m hm)] at h
    · rw [scanBody_round_tape]
      rfl
  have hexit : HaltsExactly (scanBody i dir)
      ((scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir d)) (1 + 1 + 1)
      false := by
    have h := scanBody_round i dir tape d
    rwa [notBlankAt_false i (scanTapesDir tape i dir (d + 1))
      (by rw [scanTapesDir_head]; exact heq)] at h
  have htape := TypedMachine.repeatUntilFalse_tape (scanBody i dir)
    (fun m => (scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir m))
    (fun _ => 1 + 1 + 1) d (1 + 1 + 1) hround hexit
  rw [scanBody_round_tape] at htape
  have hcost : loopCost (fun _ => 1 + 1 + 1) d + (1 + 1 + 1) = d * 4 + 3 := by
    rw [loopCost_const]
  rw [← hcost]
  show ((((scanBody i dir).repeatUntilFalse).step^[
      loopCost (fun _ => 1 + 1 + 1) d + (1 + 1 + 1)])
    ((scanToBlank i dir).startCfg tape)).tape = _
  have hcfg0 : (scanToBlank i dir).startCfg tape =
      (scanBody i dir).startCfg (scanTapesDir tape i dir 0) := by
    rw [scanTapesDir_zero]
    rfl
  rw [hcfg0]
  exact htape

end SipserGacsLautemann
