import Definitions.Def_sgl_finite_override
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sum

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

inductive OverrideState (threshold baseStates : Nat) where
  | scan : ShortScanData threshold → OverrideState threshold baseStates
  | rewind : Fin (threshold + 1) → OverrideState threshold baseStates
  | base : Fin baseStates → OverrideState threshold baseStates
  | shortAccept : OverrideState threshold baseStates
  | shortReject : OverrideState threshold baseStates

def OverrideState.equivSum (threshold baseStates : Nat) :
    OverrideState threshold baseStates ≃
      ShortScanData threshold ⊕
        (Fin (threshold + 1) ⊕ (Fin baseStates ⊕ Bool)) where
  toFun
    | .scan data => Sum.inl data
    | .rewind remaining => Sum.inr (Sum.inl remaining)
    | .base state => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl state))
    | .shortAccept => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr true))
    | .shortReject => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr false))
  invFun
    | Sum.inl data => .scan data
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inl remaining) => .rewind remaining
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl state)) => .base state
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr true)) => .shortAccept
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr false)) => .shortReject
  left_inv state := by cases state <;> rfl
  right_inv value := by
    rcases value with data | remainingOrBase
    · rfl
    · rcases remainingOrBase with remaining | baseOrResult
      · rfl
      · rcases baseOrResult with state | result
        · rfl
        · cases result <;> rfl

noncomputable instance (threshold baseStates : Nat) :
    Fintype (OverrideState threshold baseStates) :=
  Fintype.ofEquiv
    (ShortScanData threshold ⊕
      (Fin (threshold + 1) ⊕ (Fin baseStates ⊕ Bool)))
    (OverrideState.equivSum threshold baseStates).symm

def moveFirstLeft {tapes : Nat}
    (symbols : Fin (tapes + 1) → TapeSymbol) :
    Fin (tapes + 1) → TapeSymbol × HeadMove :=
  fun i =>
    if h : i.val = 0 then (symbols i, .left)
    else (symbols i, .stay)

def finPred {n : Nat} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : i.val ≠ 0) : Fin (n + 1) :=
  ⟨i.val - 1, (Nat.sub_le i.val 1).trans_lt i.isLt⟩

noncomputable def finiteOverrideTypedMachine
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates) :
    TypedMachine (tapes + 1)
      (OverrideState threshold baseStates) := by
  classical
  exact
    { start :=
        if threshold = 0 then .base baseMachine.start
        else .scan (shortMachineStartData threshold)
      transition := fun state symbols =>
        match state with
        | .shortAccept => (.shortAccept, preserveAll symbols)
        | .shortReject => (.shortReject, preserveAll symbols)
        | .base baseState =>
            let action := baseMachine.transition baseState symbols
            (.base action.1, action.2)
        | .rewind remaining =>
            if hzero : remaining.val = 0 then
              (.base baseMachine.start, preserveAll symbols)
            else
              (.rewind (finPred remaining hzero),
                moveFirstLeft symbols)
        | .scan data =>
            match symbols (firstTapeIndex tapes) with
            | .blank =>
                if data.length.val < threshold ∧
                    data.toList ∈ shortLanguage then
                  (.shortAccept, preserveAll symbols)
                else
                  (.shortReject, preserveAll symbols)
            | .bit bit =>
                if hlength : data.length.val < threshold then
                  if hmore : data.length.val + 1 < threshold then
                    (.scan (data.push bit hlength),
                      moveFirstRight symbols)
                  else
                    (.rewind data.length, preserveAll symbols)
                else
                  (.shortReject, preserveAll symbols)
      result := fun state =>
        match state with
        | .shortAccept => some true
        | .shortReject => some false
        | .base baseState => baseMachine.result baseState
        | .scan _ => none
        | .rewind _ => none }

theorem Tape.move_right_left_custom_of_right_ne_nil
    (tape : Tape) (hright : tape.right ≠ []) :
    Tape.move (Tape.move tape .right) .left = tape := by
  cases tape with
  | mk left head right =>
      cases right with
      | nil => contradiction
      | cons next rest => rfl

theorem Tape.iterate_move_right_right
    (tape : Tape) (steps : Nat) :
    (((Tape.move · .right)^[steps]) tape).right =
      (tape.head :: tape.right).drop (steps + 1) := by
  induction steps generalizing tape with
  | zero => simp
  | succ steps ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
      rw [ih]
      cases tape with
      | mk left head right =>
          cases right <;> simp [Tape.move, List.drop_succ_cons]

theorem Tape.iterate_move_right_left_custom
    (bits : List Bool) (steps : Nat)
    (hsteps : steps < bits.length) :
    ((Tape.move · .left)^[steps])
        (((Tape.move · .right)^[steps]) (Tape.ofBits bits)) =
      Tape.ofBits bits := by
  induction steps with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ steps ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply,
        Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      let current :=
        ((Tape.move · .right)^[steps]) (Tape.ofBits bits)
      have hright :
          current.right ≠ [] := by
        rw [show current.right =
            ((Tape.ofBits bits).head ::
              (Tape.ofBits bits).right).drop (steps + 1) by
          exact Tape.iterate_move_right_right
            (Tape.ofBits bits) steps]
        cases bits with
        | nil => simp at hsteps
        | cons first rest =>
            simp only [Tape.ofBits]
            have hs : steps < rest.length := by
              simpa using hsteps
            rw [List.ne_nil_iff_length_pos, List.length_drop]
            simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_map]
            omega
      have hcancel :
          Tape.move (Tape.move current .right) .left =
            current :=
        Tape.move_right_left_custom_of_right_ne_nil
          current hright
      rw [hcancel]
      exact ih (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hsteps)

def moveOnlyFirstRight {tapes State : Nat}
    (configuration : Configuration (tapes + 1) State) :
    Fin (tapes + 1) → Tape :=
  fun i =>
    if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
      Tape.move (configuration.tape i) .right
    else
      configuration.tape i

def typedMoveOnlyFirstRight {tapes : Nat} {State : Type}
    (configuration : TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1) State) :
    Fin (tapes + 1) → Tape :=
  fun i =>
    if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
      Tape.move (configuration.tape i) .right
    else
      configuration.tape i

def typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft {tapes : Nat} {State : Type}
    (configuration : TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1) State) :
    Fin (tapes + 1) → Tape :=
  fun i =>
    if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
      Tape.move (configuration.tape i) .left
    else
      configuration.tape i

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_more
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (data : ShortScanData threshold) (bit : Bool)
    (hstate : configuration.state = .scan data)
    (hhead :
      (configuration.tape (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .bit bit)
    (hlength : data.length.val < threshold)
    (hmore : data.length.val + 1 < threshold) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration =
      ⟨.scan (data.push bit hlength),
        typedMoveOnlyFirstRight configuration⟩ := by
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  rw [hhead]
  simp only
  simp only [dif_pos hlength, dif_pos hmore]
  congr 1
  funext i
  simp only [typedMoveOnlyFirstRight, moveFirstRight]
  by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
  · subst i
    simp [firstTapeIndex, Tape.write_head_eq]
  · have hival : i.val ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hi
      apply Fin.ext
      simpa [firstTapeIndex] using hzero
    simp [hi, hival, Tape.write_head_eq, Tape.move]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_last
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (data : ShortScanData threshold) (bit : Bool)
    (hstate : configuration.state = .scan data)
    (hhead :
      (configuration.tape (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .bit bit)
    (hlength : data.length.val < threshold)
    (hlast : ¬data.length.val + 1 < threshold) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration =
      ⟨.rewind data.length, configuration.tape⟩ := by
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  rw [hhead]
  simp only
  simp only [dif_pos hlength, dif_neg hlast]
  congr 1

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_blank_accept
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (data : ShortScanData threshold)
    (hstate : configuration.state = .scan data)
    (hhead :
      (configuration.tape (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .blank)
    (hcondition :
      data.length.val < threshold ∧
        data.toList ∈ shortLanguage) :
    ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration).state = OverrideState.shortAccept := by
  classical
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  rw [hhead]
  simp [hcondition]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_blank_reject
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (data : ShortScanData threshold)
    (hstate : configuration.state = .scan data)
    (hhead :
      (configuration.tape (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .blank)
    (hcondition :
      ¬(data.length.val < threshold ∧
        data.toList ∈ shortLanguage)) :
    ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration).state = OverrideState.shortReject := by
  classical
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  rw [hhead]
  simp [hcondition]

theorem TypedMachine.run_add {tapes : Nat} {State : Type}
    (machine : TypedMachine tapes State)
    (input : Fin tapes → List Bool) (first extra : Nat) :
    machine.run input (first + extra) =
      (machine.step^[extra]) (machine.run input first) := by
  induction extra with
  | zero => simp
  | succ extra ih =>
      rw [Nat.add_succ, TypedMachine.run, ih]
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']

def tapesAfterFirstRight {tapes : Nat}
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    (steps : Nat) : Fin (tapes + 1) → Tape :=
  fun i =>
    if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
      ((Tape.move · .right)^[steps]) (Tape.ofBits (input i))
    else
      Tape.ofBits (input i)

theorem ShortScanData.ofList_congr {threshold : Nat}
    {bits₁ bits₂ : List Bool}
    (hbits : bits₁ = bits₂)
    (h₁ : bits₁.length ≤ threshold)
    (h₂ : bits₂.length ≤ threshold) :
    ShortScanData.ofList bits₁ h₁ =
      ShortScanData.ofList bits₂ h₂ := by
  subst bits₂
  rfl

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_scan
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    (steps : Nat)
    (hthreshold : steps < threshold)
    (hinput : steps ≤ (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
        input steps =
      ⟨.scan
          (ShortScanData.ofList
            ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps)
            ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
              (Nat.le_of_lt hthreshold))),
        tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩ := by
  induction steps with
  | zero =>
      simp only [TypedMachine.run, TypedMachine.initialConfiguration,
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hthreshold.ne', if_false,
        tapesAfterFirstRight, Function.iterate_zero_apply,
        ShortScanData.ofList, List.take_zero, List.length_nil]
      congr 1
      funext i
      simp [tapesAfterFirstRight]
  | succ steps ih =>
      have hstepsThreshold : steps < threshold :=
        (Nat.lt_succ_self steps).trans hthreshold
      have hstepsInput :
          steps < (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length :=
        Nat.lt_of_succ_le hinput
      have ih' :=
        ih hstepsThreshold
          (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsInput)
      rw [TypedMachine.run, ih']
      have hhead :
          (tapesAfterFirstRight input steps
              (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head =
            .bit
              (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps] := by
        simp only [tapesAfterFirstRight, if_pos]
        exact
          Tape.iterate_move_right_ofBits_head_of_lt
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)) hstepsInput
      let scanned :=
        (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps
      have hscannedLength :
          scanned.length = steps :=
        List.length_take_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsInput)
      have hdataLength :
          (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
            ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
              (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsThreshold))).length.val <
              threshold := by
        change scanned.length < threshold
        rw [hscannedLength]
        exact hstepsThreshold
      have hmore :
          (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
              ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
                (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsThreshold))).length.val + 1 <
            threshold := by
        change scanned.length + 1 < threshold
        rw [hscannedLength]
        exact hthreshold
      rw [finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_more
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
        ⟨.scan
          (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
            ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
              (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsThreshold))),
          tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩
        _ _ rfl hhead hdataLength hmore]
      congr 1
      · congr 2
        have hpush :=
          ShortScanData.push_ofList scanned
            (by simpa [hscannedLength] using hstepsThreshold)
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]
        have htake :
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take (steps + 1) =
              scanned ++
                [(input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]] := by
          simpa [scanned] using
            List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hstepsInput
        calc
          (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
              ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
                (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsThreshold))).push
                (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps] hdataLength
              =
            (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
              (Nat.le_of_lt
                (by simpa [hscannedLength] using hstepsThreshold))).push
                (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]
                (by
                  change scanned.length < threshold
                  rw [hscannedLength]
                  exact hstepsThreshold) := by
                  congr
          _ =
            ShortScanData.ofList
              (scanned ++
                [(input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]])
              (by
                simpa [hscannedLength] using
                  Nat.succ_le_of_lt hstepsThreshold) := hpush
          _ =
            ShortScanData.ofList
              ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take (steps + 1))
              ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
                (Nat.le_of_lt hthreshold)) :=
            ShortScanData.ofList_congr htake.symm _ _
      · funext i
        simp only [typedMoveOnlyFirstRight,
          tapesAfterFirstRight]
        by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
        · subst i
          simp only [if_pos]
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        · simp only [hi, if_false]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_rewind_zero
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (remaining : Fin (threshold + 1))
    (hstate : configuration.state = .rewind remaining)
    (hzero : remaining.val = 0) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration =
      ⟨.base baseMachine.start, configuration.tape⟩ := by
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  simp only [dif_pos hzero]
  congr 1

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_rewind_succ
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (remaining : Fin (threshold + 1))
    (hstate : configuration.state = .rewind remaining)
    (hnonzero : remaining.val ≠ 0) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration =
      ⟨.rewind (finPred remaining hnonzero),
        typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft configuration⟩ := by
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  simp only [dif_neg hnonzero]
  congr 1
  funext i
  simp only [typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft, moveFirstLeft]
  by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
  · subst i
    simp [firstTapeIndex, Tape.write_head_eq]
  · have hival : i.val ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hi
      apply Fin.ext
      simpa [firstTapeIndex] using hzero
    simp [hi, hival, Tape.write_head_eq, Tape.move]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_iterate_rewind
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (remaining : Fin (threshold + 1))
    (hstate : configuration.state = .rewind remaining) :
    ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        ^[remaining.val + 1]) configuration =
      ⟨.base baseMachine.start,
        fun i =>
          if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
            ((Tape.move · .left)^[remaining.val])
              (configuration.tape i)
          else
            configuration.tape i⟩ := by
  induction hvalue : remaining.val using Nat.strong_induction_on
      generalizing configuration remaining with
  | h value ih =>
      by_cases hzero : remaining.val = 0
      · have hvalueZero : value = 0 := by omega
        subst value
        have hexponent : remaining.val + 1 = 1 := by omega
        rw [hexponent, Function.iterate_one]
        simp only [hzero, Function.iterate_zero_apply]
        rw [finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_rewind_zero
          shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
          configuration remaining hstate hzero]
        congr 1
        funext i
        simp
      · have hpositive : 0 < remaining.val :=
          Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
        have hpredVal :
            (finPred remaining hzero).val =
              remaining.val - 1 := rfl
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
        have hstep :=
          finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_rewind_succ
            shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
            configuration remaining hstate hzero
        rw [hstep]
        have ih' :=
          ih (remaining.val - 1)
            (by omega)
            ⟨.rewind (finPred remaining hzero),
              typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft configuration⟩
            (finPred remaining hzero) rfl rfl
        have hvaluePred :
            value = remaining.val - 1 + 1 := by omega
        rw [hvaluePred, ih']
        congr 1
        funext i
        by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
        · subst i
          simp only [if_pos, typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft]
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
        · simp [hi, typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_enter_base
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    (hlong :
      threshold ≤ (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
        input (2 * threshold) =
      ⟨.base baseMachine.start,
        fun i => Tape.ofBits (input i)⟩ := by
  cases threshold with
  | zero =>
      simp [finiteOverrideTypedMachine,
        TypedMachine.run, TypedMachine.initialConfiguration]
  | succ steps =>
      have hscan :=
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_scan
          shortLanguage (steps + 1) baseMachine input steps
          (Nat.lt_succ_self steps)
          (by omega)
      let data :=
        ShortScanData.ofList
          ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps)
          ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
            (Nat.le_succ steps))
      have hstepsInput :
          steps < (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length := by
        omega
      have hhead :
          (tapesAfterFirstRight input steps
              (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head =
            .bit
              (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps] := by
        simp only [tapesAfterFirstRight, if_pos]
        exact
          Tape.iterate_move_right_ofBits_head_of_lt
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)) hstepsInput
      have hdataLength :
          data.length.val < steps + 1 := by
        change
          ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps).length <
            steps + 1
        rw [List.length_take_of_le hstepsInput.le]
        omega
      have hlast :
          ¬data.length.val + 1 < steps + 1 := by
        change
          ¬((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps).length + 1 <
            steps + 1
        rw [List.length_take_of_le hstepsInput.le]
        omega
      have henter :
          (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage (steps + 1)
              baseMachine).run input (steps + 1) =
            ⟨.rewind data.length,
              tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩ := by
        rw [TypedMachine.run, hscan]
        exact
          finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_last
            shortLanguage (steps + 1) baseMachine
            ⟨.scan data, tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩
            data (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]
            rfl hhead hdataLength hlast
      have hrewind :=
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine_iterate_rewind
          shortLanguage (steps + 1) baseMachine
          ⟨.rewind data.length,
            tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩
          data.length rfl
      have hdataVal : data.length.val = steps := by
        change
          ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps).length =
            steps
        exact List.length_take_of_le hstepsInput.le
      have htime :
          2 * (steps + 1) =
            (steps + 1) + (data.length.val + 1) := by
        omega
      rw [htime, TypedMachine.run_add, henter, hrewind]
      congr 1
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
      · subst i
        simp only [if_pos, tapesAfterFirstRight]
        rw [hdataVal]
        exact
          Tape.iterate_move_right_left_custom
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)) steps hstepsInput
      · simp [hi, tapesAfterFirstRight]

def embedBaseConfiguration
    {tapes baseStates threshold : Nat}
    (configuration : Configuration (tapes + 1) baseStates) :
    TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
      (OverrideState threshold baseStates) :=
  ⟨.base configuration.state, configuration.tape⟩

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_embedBase
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration : Configuration (tapes + 1) baseStates) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        (embedBaseConfiguration
          (threshold := threshold) configuration) =
      embedBaseConfiguration
        (threshold := threshold)
        (baseMachine.step configuration) := by
  cases hresult : baseMachine.result configuration.state with
  | some result =>
      unfold TypedMachine.step Machine.step
      simp [embedBaseConfiguration,
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hresult]
  | none =>
      unfold TypedMachine.step Machine.step
      simp [embedBaseConfiguration,
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hresult]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_iterate_embedBase
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration : Configuration (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (steps : Nat) :
    ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        ^[steps])
        (embedBaseConfiguration
          (threshold := threshold) configuration) =
      embedBaseConfiguration
        (threshold := threshold)
        ((baseMachine.step^[steps]) configuration) := by
  induction steps generalizing configuration with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ steps ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
      rw [finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_embedBase]
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
      exact ih (baseMachine.step configuration)

theorem Machine.run_add {tapes states : Nat}
    (machine : Machine tapes states)
    (input : Fin tapes → List Bool) (first extra : Nat) :
    machine.run input (first + extra) =
      (machine.step^[extra]) (machine.run input first) := by
  induction extra with
  | zero => simp
  | succ extra ih =>
      rw [Nat.add_succ, Machine.run, ih]
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_long
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    (hlong :
      threshold ≤ (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length)
    (steps : Nat) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
        input (2 * threshold + steps) =
      embedBaseConfiguration
        (threshold := threshold)
        (baseMachine.run input steps) := by
  rw [TypedMachine.run_add,
    finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_enter_base
      shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input hlong]
  change
    ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        ^[steps])
        (embedBaseConfiguration
          (threshold := threshold)
          (SipserGacsLautemann.initialConfiguration
            baseMachine input)) =
      embedBaseConfiguration
        (threshold := threshold)
        (baseMachine.run input steps)
  rw [finiteOverrideTypedMachine_iterate_embedBase]
  congr 1
  simpa [Machine.run] using
    (Machine.run_add baseMachine input 0 steps).symm

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_result_short_early
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    [Decidable
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage)]
    (hshort :
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).result
        ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
          input
          ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length + 1)).state =
      some
        (decide
          (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage)) := by
  classical
  let length :=
    (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length
  have hscan :=
    finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_scan
      shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input length
      hshort le_rfl
  let data :=
    ShortScanData.ofList
      ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take length)
      ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans hshort.le)
  have hhead :
      (tapesAfterFirstRight input length
          (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .blank := by
    simp only [tapesAfterFirstRight, if_pos]
    exact
      Tape.iterate_move_right_ofBits_head_length
        (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))
  have hdataList :
      data.toList = input (firstTapeIndex tapes) := by
    dsimp [data]
    rw [ShortScanData.toList_ofList]
    exact List.take_length
  have hdataLength :
      data.length.val < threshold := by
    change
      ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take length).length <
        threshold
    rw [List.take_length]
    exact hshort
  rw [TypedMachine.run, hscan]
  by_cases hmember :
      input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage
  · have hstep :=
      finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_blank_accept
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
        ⟨.scan data, tapesAfterFirstRight input length⟩
        data rfl hhead
        ⟨hdataLength, by simpa [hdataList]⟩
    rw [hstep]
    simp [finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hmember]
  · have hstep :=
      finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_blank_reject
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
        ⟨.scan data, tapesAfterFirstRight input length⟩
        data rfl hhead
        (by simp [hdataList, hmember])
    rw [hstep]
    simp [finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hmember]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_result_short
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    [Decidable
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage)]
    (hshort :
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold)
    (totalSteps : Nat)
    (htotal :
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length + 1 ≤ totalSteps) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).result
        ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
          input totalSteps).state =
      some
        (decide
          (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage)) := by
  obtain ⟨extra, rfl⟩ :=
    Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le htotal
  have hearly :=
    finiteOverrideTypedMachine_result_short_early
      shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input hshort
  have hrun :=
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
      ).run_add_eq_of_result_run_eq_some
      input
      ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length + 1)
      extra hearly
  rw [hrun]
  exact hearly

theorem polynomiallyBounded_add_constant
    {time : Nat → Nat} (constant : Nat)
    (htime : PolynomiallyBounded time) :
    PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => constant + time n) := by
  rcases htime with ⟨coefficient, degree, hbound⟩
  refine ⟨constant + coefficient, degree, ?_⟩
  intro n
  have hpower : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ degree :=
    Nat.one_le_pow degree (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
  have hconstant :
      constant ≤ constant * (n + 1) ^ degree := by
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left constant hpower
  calc
    constant + time n ≤
        constant * (n + 1) ^ degree +
          coefficient * (n + 1) ^ degree := by
      exact Nat.add_le_add hconstant (hbound n)
    _ = (constant + coefficient) *
          (n + 1) ^ degree := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]

theorem decidesInPolynomialTime_finiteOverride
    {tapes : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (basePredicate :
      (Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool) → Prop)
    (hbase : DecidesInPolynomialTime basePredicate) :
    DecidesInPolynomialTime
      (fun input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool =>
        if (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold then
          input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage
        else
          basePredicate input) := by
  classical
  rcases hbase with
    ⟨baseStates, baseMachine, baseTime,
      hbaseTime, hbaseCorrect⟩
  let typedMachine :=
    finiteOverrideTypedMachine
      shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
  let machine := typedMachine.toMachine
  let time : Nat → Nat :=
    fun n => 2 * threshold + baseTime n
  refine
    ⟨Fintype.card (OverrideState threshold baseStates),
      machine, time,
      polynomiallyBounded_add_constant
        (2 * threshold) hbaseTime,
      ?_⟩
  intro input
  let totalLength := totalInputLength input
  let baseSteps := baseTime totalLength
  by_cases hshort :
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold
  · have htotal :
        (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length + 1 ≤
          2 * threshold + baseSteps := by
      omega
    letI :
        Decidable
          (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage) :=
      Classical.propDecidable _
    have hresult :=
      finiteOverrideTypedMachine_result_short
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input
        hshort (2 * threshold + baseSteps) htotal
    constructor
    · rw [typedMachine.toMachine_acceptsWithin_iff]
      simpa [typedMachine, machine, time, baseSteps,
        totalLength, hshort] using
        (show
          typedMachine.result
              (typedMachine.run input
                (2 * threshold + baseSteps)).state =
                some true ↔
            input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage by
          rw [hresult]
          simp)
    · rw [typedMachine.toMachine_rejectsWithin_iff]
      simpa [typedMachine, machine, time, baseSteps,
        totalLength, hshort] using
        (show
          typedMachine.result
              (typedMachine.run input
                (2 * threshold + baseSteps)).state =
                some false ↔
            ¬input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage by
          rw [hresult]
          simp)
  · have hlong :
        threshold ≤
          (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length :=
      Nat.le_of_not_gt hshort
    have hrun :=
      finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_long
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input
        hlong baseSteps
    have hbaseInput := hbaseCorrect input
    constructor
    · rw [typedMachine.toMachine_acceptsWithin_iff]
      change
        typedMachine.result
            (typedMachine.run input
              (2 * threshold + baseSteps)).state =
              some true ↔
          (if
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold
           then input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage
           else basePredicate input)
      rw [hrun]
      change
        baseMachine.result
            (baseMachine.run input baseSteps).state =
              some true ↔ _
      simpa [hshort, Machine.acceptsWithin,
        baseSteps, totalLength] using hbaseInput.1
    · rw [typedMachine.toMachine_rejectsWithin_iff]
      change
        typedMachine.result
            (typedMachine.run input
              (2 * threshold + baseSteps)).state =
              some false ↔
          ¬(if
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold
           then input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage
           else basePredicate input)
      rw [hrun]
      change
        baseMachine.result
            (baseMachine.run input baseSteps).state =
              some false ↔ _
      simpa [hshort, Machine.rejectsWithin,
        baseSteps, totalLength] using hbaseInput.2

theorem DecidesInPolynomialTime.congr
    {tapes : Nat}
    {predicate₁ predicate₂ :
      (Fin tapes → List Bool) → Prop}
    (hdecides : DecidesInPolynomialTime predicate₁)
    (hequiv : ∀ input, predicate₁ input ↔ predicate₂ input) :
    DecidesInPolynomialTime predicate₂ := by
  rcases hdecides with
    ⟨states, machine, time, htime, hcorrect⟩
  refine ⟨states, machine, time, htime, ?_⟩
  intro input
  constructor
  · exact (hcorrect input).1.trans (hequiv input)
  · exact (hcorrect input).2.trans (not_congr (hequiv input))

end SipserGacsLautemann
theorems.natural_language_statement: A sorry-free generic machine construction that decides a fixed finite language on inputs shorter than a threshold and otherwise restores the initial tapes exactly before delegating to an arbitrary polynomial-time base machine. It includes the exact run simulation and polynomial time bound.
theorems.source: Reusable finite-exception closure construction for the custom Turing-machine model in the Sipser–Gács–Lautemann mission.

theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_finite_override
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sum

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

inductive OverrideState (threshold baseStates : Nat) where
  | scan : ShortScanData threshold → OverrideState threshold baseStates
  | rewind : Fin (threshold + 1) → OverrideState threshold baseStates
  | base : Fin baseStates → OverrideState threshold baseStates
  | shortAccept : OverrideState threshold baseStates
  | shortReject : OverrideState threshold baseStates

def OverrideState.equivSum (threshold baseStates : Nat) :
    OverrideState threshold baseStates ≃
      ShortScanData threshold ⊕
        (Fin (threshold + 1) ⊕ (Fin baseStates ⊕ Bool)) where
  toFun
    | .scan data => Sum.inl data
    | .rewind remaining => Sum.inr (Sum.inl remaining)
    | .base state => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl state))
    | .shortAccept => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr true))
    | .shortReject => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr false))
  invFun
    | Sum.inl data => .scan data
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inl remaining) => .rewind remaining
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl state)) => .base state
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr true)) => .shortAccept
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr false)) => .shortReject
  left_inv state := by cases state <;> rfl
  right_inv value := by
    rcases value with data | remainingOrBase
    · rfl
    · rcases remainingOrBase with remaining | baseOrResult
      · rfl
      · rcases baseOrResult with state | result
        · rfl
        · cases result <;> rfl

noncomputable instance (threshold baseStates : Nat) :
    Fintype (OverrideState threshold baseStates) :=
  Fintype.ofEquiv
    (ShortScanData threshold ⊕
      (Fin (threshold + 1) ⊕ (Fin baseStates ⊕ Bool)))
    (OverrideState.equivSum threshold baseStates).symm

def moveFirstLeft {tapes : Nat}
    (symbols : Fin (tapes + 1) → TapeSymbol) :
    Fin (tapes + 1) → TapeSymbol × HeadMove :=
  fun i =>
    if h : i.val = 0 then (symbols i, .left)
    else (symbols i, .stay)

def finPred {n : Nat} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : i.val ≠ 0) : Fin (n + 1) :=
  ⟨i.val - 1, (Nat.sub_le i.val 1).trans_lt i.isLt⟩

noncomputable def finiteOverrideTypedMachine
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates) :
    TypedMachine (tapes + 1)
      (OverrideState threshold baseStates) := by
  classical
  exact
    { start :=
        if threshold = 0 then .base baseMachine.start
        else .scan (shortMachineStartData threshold)
      transition := fun state symbols =>
        match state with
        | .shortAccept => (.shortAccept, preserveAll symbols)
        | .shortReject => (.shortReject, preserveAll symbols)
        | .base baseState =>
            let action := baseMachine.transition baseState symbols
            (.base action.1, action.2)
        | .rewind remaining =>
            if hzero : remaining.val = 0 then
              (.base baseMachine.start, preserveAll symbols)
            else
              (.rewind (finPred remaining hzero),
                moveFirstLeft symbols)
        | .scan data =>
            match symbols (firstTapeIndex tapes) with
            | .blank =>
                if data.length.val < threshold ∧
                    data.toList ∈ shortLanguage then
                  (.shortAccept, preserveAll symbols)
                else
                  (.shortReject, preserveAll symbols)
            | .bit bit =>
                if hlength : data.length.val < threshold then
                  if hmore : data.length.val + 1 < threshold then
                    (.scan (data.push bit hlength),
                      moveFirstRight symbols)
                  else
                    (.rewind data.length, preserveAll symbols)
                else
                  (.shortReject, preserveAll symbols)
      result := fun state =>
        match state with
        | .shortAccept => some true
        | .shortReject => some false
        | .base baseState => baseMachine.result baseState
        | .scan _ => none
        | .rewind _ => none }

theorem Tape.move_right_left_custom_of_right_ne_nil
    (tape : Tape) (hright : tape.right ≠ []) :
    Tape.move (Tape.move tape .right) .left = tape := by
  cases tape with
  | mk left head right =>
      cases right with
      | nil => contradiction
      | cons next rest => rfl

theorem Tape.iterate_move_right_right
    (tape : Tape) (steps : Nat) :
    (((Tape.move · .right)^[steps]) tape).right =
      (tape.head :: tape.right).drop (steps + 1) := by
  induction steps generalizing tape with
  | zero => simp
  | succ steps ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
      rw [ih]
      cases tape with
      | mk left head right =>
          cases right <;> simp [Tape.move, List.drop_succ_cons]

theorem Tape.iterate_move_right_left_custom
    (bits : List Bool) (steps : Nat)
    (hsteps : steps < bits.length) :
    ((Tape.move · .left)^[steps])
        (((Tape.move · .right)^[steps]) (Tape.ofBits bits)) =
      Tape.ofBits bits := by
  induction steps with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ steps ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply,
        Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      let current :=
        ((Tape.move · .right)^[steps]) (Tape.ofBits bits)
      have hright :
          current.right ≠ [] := by
        rw [show current.right =
            ((Tape.ofBits bits).head ::
              (Tape.ofBits bits).right).drop (steps + 1) by
          exact Tape.iterate_move_right_right
            (Tape.ofBits bits) steps]
        cases bits with
        | nil => simp at hsteps
        | cons first rest =>
            simp only [Tape.ofBits]
            have hs : steps < rest.length := by
              simpa using hsteps
            rw [List.ne_nil_iff_length_pos, List.length_drop]
            simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_map]
            omega
      have hcancel :
          Tape.move (Tape.move current .right) .left =
            current :=
        Tape.move_right_left_custom_of_right_ne_nil
          current hright
      rw [hcancel]
      exact ih (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hsteps)

def moveOnlyFirstRight {tapes State : Nat}
    (configuration : Configuration (tapes + 1) State) :
    Fin (tapes + 1) → Tape :=
  fun i =>
    if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
      Tape.move (configuration.tape i) .right
    else
      configuration.tape i

def typedMoveOnlyFirstRight {tapes : Nat} {State : Type}
    (configuration : TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1) State) :
    Fin (tapes + 1) → Tape :=
  fun i =>
    if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
      Tape.move (configuration.tape i) .right
    else
      configuration.tape i

def typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft {tapes : Nat} {State : Type}
    (configuration : TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1) State) :
    Fin (tapes + 1) → Tape :=
  fun i =>
    if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
      Tape.move (configuration.tape i) .left
    else
      configuration.tape i

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_more
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (data : ShortScanData threshold) (bit : Bool)
    (hstate : configuration.state = .scan data)
    (hhead :
      (configuration.tape (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .bit bit)
    (hlength : data.length.val < threshold)
    (hmore : data.length.val + 1 < threshold) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration =
      ⟨.scan (data.push bit hlength),
        typedMoveOnlyFirstRight configuration⟩ := by
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  rw [hhead]
  simp only
  simp only [dif_pos hlength, dif_pos hmore]
  congr 1
  funext i
  simp only [typedMoveOnlyFirstRight, moveFirstRight]
  by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
  · subst i
    simp [firstTapeIndex, Tape.write_head_eq]
  · have hival : i.val ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hi
      apply Fin.ext
      simpa [firstTapeIndex] using hzero
    simp [hi, hival, Tape.write_head_eq, Tape.move]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_last
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (data : ShortScanData threshold) (bit : Bool)
    (hstate : configuration.state = .scan data)
    (hhead :
      (configuration.tape (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .bit bit)
    (hlength : data.length.val < threshold)
    (hlast : ¬data.length.val + 1 < threshold) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration =
      ⟨.rewind data.length, configuration.tape⟩ := by
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  rw [hhead]
  simp only
  simp only [dif_pos hlength, dif_neg hlast]
  congr 1

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_blank_accept
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (data : ShortScanData threshold)
    (hstate : configuration.state = .scan data)
    (hhead :
      (configuration.tape (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .blank)
    (hcondition :
      data.length.val < threshold ∧
        data.toList ∈ shortLanguage) :
    ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration).state = OverrideState.shortAccept := by
  classical
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  rw [hhead]
  simp [hcondition]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_blank_reject
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))

      (configuration.tape (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .blank)
    (hcondition :
      ¬(data.length.val < threshold ∧
        data.toList ∈ shortLanguage)) :

theorem TypedMachine.run_add {tapes : Nat} {State : Type}
    (machine : TypedMachine tapes State)
    (input : Fin tapes → List Bool) (first extra : Nat) :
    machine.run input (first + extra) =
      (machine.step^[extra]) (machine.run input first) := by
  induction extra with
  | zero => simp
  | succ extra ih =>
      rw [Nat.add_succ, TypedMachine.run, ih]
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']

def tapesAfterFirstRight {tapes : Nat}
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    (steps : Nat) : Fin (tapes + 1) → Tape :=
  fun i =>
    if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
      ((Tape.move · .right)^[steps]) (Tape.ofBits (input i))
    else
      Tape.ofBits (input i)

theorem ShortScanData.ofList_congr {threshold : Nat}
    {bits₁ bits₂ : List Bool}
    (hbits : bits₁ = bits₂)
    (h₁ : bits₁.length ≤ threshold)
    (h₂ : bits₂.length ≤ threshold) :
    ShortScanData.ofList bits₁ h₁ =
      ShortScanData.ofList bits₂ h₂ := by
  subst bits₂
  rfl

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_scan
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    (steps : Nat)
    (hthreshold : steps < threshold)
    (hinput : steps ≤ (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
        input steps =
      ⟨.scan
          (ShortScanData.ofList
            ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps)
            ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
              (Nat.le_of_lt hthreshold))),
        tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩ := by
  induction steps with
  | zero =>
      simp only [TypedMachine.run, TypedMachine.initialConfiguration,
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hthreshold.ne', if_false,
        tapesAfterFirstRight, Function.iterate_zero_apply,
        ShortScanData.ofList, List.take_zero, List.length_nil]
      congr 1
      funext i
      simp [tapesAfterFirstRight]
  | succ steps ih =>
      have hstepsThreshold : steps < threshold :=
        (Nat.lt_succ_self steps).trans hthreshold
      have hstepsInput :
          steps < (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length :=
        Nat.lt_of_succ_le hinput
      have ih' :=
        ih hstepsThreshold
          (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsInput)
      rw [TypedMachine.run, ih']
      have hhead :
          (tapesAfterFirstRight input steps
              (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head =
            .bit
              (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps] := by
        simp only [tapesAfterFirstRight, if_pos]
        exact
          Tape.iterate_move_right_ofBits_head_of_lt
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)) hstepsInput
      let scanned :=
        (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps
      have hscannedLength :
          scanned.length = steps :=
        List.length_take_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsInput)
      have hdataLength :
          (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
            ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
              (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsThreshold))).length.val <
              threshold := by
        change scanned.length < threshold
        rw [hscannedLength]
        exact hstepsThreshold
      have hmore :
          (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
              ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
                (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsThreshold))).length.val + 1 <
            threshold := by
        change scanned.length + 1 < threshold
        rw [hscannedLength]
        exact hthreshold
      rw [finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_more
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
        ⟨.scan
          (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
            ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
              (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsThreshold))),
          tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩
        _ _ rfl hhead hdataLength hmore]
      congr 1
      · congr 2
        have hpush :=
          ShortScanData.push_ofList scanned
            (by simpa [hscannedLength] using hstepsThreshold)
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]
        have htake :
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take (steps + 1) =
              scanned ++
                [(input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]] := by
          simpa [scanned] using
            List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hstepsInput
        calc
          (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
              ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
                (Nat.le_of_lt hstepsThreshold))).push
                (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps] hdataLength
              =
            (ShortScanData.ofList scanned
              (Nat.le_of_lt
                (by simpa [hscannedLength] using hstepsThreshold))).push
                (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]
                (by
                  change scanned.length < threshold
                  rw [hscannedLength]
                  exact hstepsThreshold) := by
                  congr
          _ =
            ShortScanData.ofList
              (scanned ++
                [(input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]])
              (by
                simpa [hscannedLength] using
                  Nat.succ_le_of_lt hstepsThreshold) := hpush
          _ =
            ShortScanData.ofList
              ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take (steps + 1))
              ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
                (Nat.le_of_lt hthreshold)) :=
            ShortScanData.ofList_congr htake.symm _ _
      · funext i
        simp only [typedMoveOnlyFirstRight,
          tapesAfterFirstRight]
        by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
        · subst i
          simp only [if_pos]
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        · simp only [hi, if_false]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_rewind_zero
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (remaining : Fin (threshold + 1))
    (hstate : configuration.state = .rewind remaining)
    (hzero : remaining.val = 0) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration =
      ⟨.base baseMachine.start, configuration.tape⟩ := by
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  simp only [dif_pos hzero]
  congr 1

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_rewind_succ
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (remaining : Fin (threshold + 1))
    (hstate : configuration.state = .rewind remaining)
    (hnonzero : remaining.val ≠ 0) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        configuration =
      ⟨.rewind (finPred remaining hnonzero),
        typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft configuration⟩ := by
  unfold TypedMachine.step
  rw [hstate]
  simp only [finiteOverrideTypedMachine]
  simp only [dif_neg hnonzero]
  congr 1
  funext i
  simp only [typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft, moveFirstLeft]
  by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
  · subst i
    simp [firstTapeIndex, Tape.write_head_eq]
  · have hival : i.val ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hi
      apply Fin.ext
      simpa [firstTapeIndex] using hzero
    simp [hi, hival, Tape.write_head_eq, Tape.move]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_iterate_rewind
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration :
      TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
        (OverrideState threshold baseStates))
    (remaining : Fin (threshold + 1))
    (hstate : configuration.state = .rewind remaining) :
    ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        ^[remaining.val + 1]) configuration =
      ⟨.base baseMachine.start,
        fun i =>
          if i = firstTapeIndex tapes then
            ((Tape.move · .left)^[remaining.val])
              (configuration.tape i)
          else
            configuration.tape i⟩ := by
  induction hvalue : remaining.val using Nat.strong_induction_on
      generalizing configuration remaining with
  | h value ih =>
      by_cases hzero : remaining.val = 0
      · have hvalueZero : value = 0 := by omega
        subst value
        have hexponent : remaining.val + 1 = 1 := by omega
        rw [hexponent, Function.iterate_one]
        simp only [hzero, Function.iterate_zero_apply]
        rw [finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_rewind_zero
          shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
          configuration remaining hstate hzero]
        congr 1
        funext i
        simp
      · have hpositive : 0 < remaining.val :=
          Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
        have hpredVal :
            (finPred remaining hzero).val =
              remaining.val - 1 := rfl
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
        have hstep :=
          finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_rewind_succ
            shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
            configuration remaining hstate hzero
        rw [hstep]
        have ih' :=
          ih (remaining.val - 1)
            (by omega)
            ⟨.rewind (finPred remaining hzero),
              typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft configuration⟩
            (finPred remaining hzero) rfl rfl
        have hvaluePred :
            value = remaining.val - 1 + 1 := by omega
        rw [hvaluePred, ih']
        congr 1
        funext i
        by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
        · subst i
          simp only [if_pos, typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft]
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
        · simp [hi, typedMoveOnlyFirstLeft]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_enter_base
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    (hlong :
      threshold ≤ (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
        input (2 * threshold) =
      ⟨.base baseMachine.start,
        fun i => Tape.ofBits (input i)⟩ := by
  cases threshold with
  | zero =>
      simp [finiteOverrideTypedMachine,
        TypedMachine.run, TypedMachine.initialConfiguration]
  | succ steps =>
      have hscan :=
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_scan
          shortLanguage (steps + 1) baseMachine input steps
          (Nat.lt_succ_self steps)
          (by omega)
      let data :=
        ShortScanData.ofList
          ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps)
          ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans
            (Nat.le_succ steps))
      have hstepsInput :
          steps < (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length := by
        omega
      have hhead :
          (tapesAfterFirstRight input steps
              (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head =
            .bit
              (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps] := by
        simp only [tapesAfterFirstRight, if_pos]
        exact
          Tape.iterate_move_right_ofBits_head_of_lt
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)) hstepsInput
      have hdataLength :
          data.length.val < steps + 1 := by
        change
          ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps).length <
            steps + 1
        rw [List.length_take_of_le hstepsInput.le]
        omega
      have hlast :
          ¬data.length.val + 1 < steps + 1 := by
        change
          ¬((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps).length + 1 <
            steps + 1
        rw [List.length_take_of_le hstepsInput.le]
        omega
      have henter :
          (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage (steps + 1)
              baseMachine).run input (steps + 1) =
            ⟨.rewind data.length,
              tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩ := by
        rw [TypedMachine.run, hscan]
        exact
          finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_last
            shortLanguage (steps + 1) baseMachine
            ⟨.scan data, tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩
            data (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))[steps]
            rfl hhead hdataLength hlast
      have hrewind :=
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine_iterate_rewind
          shortLanguage (steps + 1) baseMachine
          ⟨.rewind data.length,
            tapesAfterFirstRight input steps⟩
          data.length rfl
      have hdataVal : data.length.val = steps := by
        change
          ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take steps).length =
            steps
        exact List.length_take_of_le hstepsInput.le
      have htime :
          2 * (steps + 1) =
            (steps + 1) + (data.length.val + 1) := by
        omega
      rw [htime, TypedMachine.run_add, henter, hrewind]
      congr 1
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = firstTapeIndex tapes
      · subst i
        simp only [if_pos, tapesAfterFirstRight]
        rw [hdataVal]
        exact
          Tape.iterate_move_right_left_custom
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)) steps hstepsInput
      · simp [hi, tapesAfterFirstRight]

def embedBaseConfiguration
    {tapes baseStates threshold : Nat}
    (configuration : Configuration (tapes + 1) baseStates) :
    TypedConfiguration (tapes + 1)
      (OverrideState threshold baseStates) :=
  ⟨.base configuration.state, configuration.tape⟩

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_embedBase
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration : Configuration (tapes + 1) baseStates) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        (embedBaseConfiguration
          (threshold := threshold) configuration) =
      embedBaseConfiguration
        (threshold := threshold)
        (baseMachine.step configuration) := by
  cases hresult : baseMachine.result configuration.state with
  | some result =>
      unfold TypedMachine.step Machine.step
      simp [embedBaseConfiguration,
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hresult]
  | none =>
      unfold TypedMachine.step Machine.step
      simp [embedBaseConfiguration,
        finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hresult]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_iterate_embedBase
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (configuration : Configuration (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (steps : Nat) :
    ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        ^[steps])
        (embedBaseConfiguration
          (threshold := threshold) configuration) =
      embedBaseConfiguration
        (threshold := threshold)
        ((baseMachine.step^[steps]) configuration) := by
  induction steps generalizing configuration with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ steps ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
      rw [finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_embedBase]
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
      exact ih (baseMachine.step configuration)

theorem Machine.run_add {tapes states : Nat}
    (machine : Machine tapes states)
    (input : Fin tapes → List Bool) (first extra : Nat) :
    machine.run input (first + extra) =
      (machine.step^[extra]) (machine.run input first) := by
  induction extra with
  | zero => simp
  | succ extra ih =>
      rw [Nat.add_succ, Machine.run, ih]
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_long
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    (hlong :
      threshold ≤ (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length)
    (steps : Nat) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
        input (2 * threshold + steps) =
      embedBaseConfiguration
        (threshold := threshold)
        (baseMachine.run input steps) := by
  rw [TypedMachine.run_add,
    finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_enter_base
      shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input hlong]
  change
    ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).step
        ^[steps])
        (embedBaseConfiguration
          (threshold := threshold)
          (SipserGacsLautemann.initialConfiguration
            baseMachine input)) =
      embedBaseConfiguration
        (threshold := threshold)
        (baseMachine.run input steps)
  rw [finiteOverrideTypedMachine_iterate_embedBase]
  congr 1
  simpa [Machine.run] using
    (Machine.run_add baseMachine input 0 steps).symm

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_result_short_early
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    [Decidable
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage)]
    (hshort :
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).result
        ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
          input
          ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length + 1)).state =
      some
        (decide
          (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage)) := by
  classical
  let length :=
    (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length
  have hscan :=
    finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_scan
      shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input length
      hshort le_rfl
  let data :=
    ShortScanData.ofList
      ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take length)
      ((List.length_take_le _ _).trans hshort.le)
  have hhead :
      (tapesAfterFirstRight input length
          (firstTapeIndex tapes)).head = .blank := by
    simp only [tapesAfterFirstRight, if_pos]
    exact
      Tape.iterate_move_right_ofBits_head_length
        (input (firstTapeIndex tapes))
  have hdataList :
      data.toList = input (firstTapeIndex tapes) := by
    dsimp [data]
    rw [ShortScanData.toList_ofList]
    exact List.take_length
  have hdataLength :
      data.length.val < threshold := by
    change
      ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).take length).length <
        threshold
    rw [List.take_length]
    exact hshort
  rw [TypedMachine.run, hscan]
  by_cases hmember :
      input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage
  · have hstep :=
      finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_blank_accept
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
        ⟨.scan data, tapesAfterFirstRight input length⟩
        data rfl hhead
        ⟨hdataLength, by simpa [hdataList]⟩
    rw [hstep]
    simp [finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hmember]
  · have hstep :=
      finiteOverrideTypedMachine_step_scan_blank_reject
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
        ⟨.scan data, tapesAfterFirstRight input length⟩
        data rfl hhead
        (by simp [hdataList, hmember])
    rw [hstep]
    simp [finiteOverrideTypedMachine, hmember]

theorem finiteOverrideTypedMachine_result_short
    {tapes baseStates : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (baseMachine : Machine (tapes + 1) baseStates)
    (input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool)
    [Decidable
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage)]
    (hshort :
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold)
    (totalSteps : Nat)
    (htotal :
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length + 1 ≤ totalSteps) :
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).result
        ((finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine).run
          input totalSteps).state =
      some
        (decide
          (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage)) := by
  obtain ⟨extra, rfl⟩ :=
    Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le htotal
  have hearly :=
    finiteOverrideTypedMachine_result_short_early
      shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input hshort
  have hrun :=
    (finiteOverrideTypedMachine shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
      ).run_add_eq_of_result_run_eq_some
      input
      ((input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length + 1)
      extra hearly
  rw [hrun]
  exact hearly

theorem polynomiallyBounded_add_constant
    {time : Nat → Nat} (constant : Nat)
    (htime : PolynomiallyBounded time) :
    PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => constant + time n) := by
  rcases htime with ⟨coefficient, degree, hbound⟩
  refine ⟨constant + coefficient, degree, ?_⟩
  intro n
  have hpower : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ degree :=
    Nat.one_le_pow degree (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
  have hconstant :
      constant ≤ constant * (n + 1) ^ degree := by
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left constant hpower
  calc
    constant + time n ≤
        constant * (n + 1) ^ degree +
          coefficient * (n + 1) ^ degree := by
      exact Nat.add_le_add hconstant (hbound n)
    _ = (constant + coefficient) *
          (n + 1) ^ degree := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]

theorem decidesInPolynomialTime_finiteOverride
    {tapes : Nat}
    (shortLanguage : Language) (threshold : Nat)
    (basePredicate :
      (Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool) → Prop)
    (hbase : DecidesInPolynomialTime basePredicate) :
    DecidesInPolynomialTime
      (fun input : Fin (tapes + 1) → List Bool =>
        if (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold then
          input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage
        else
          basePredicate input) := by
  classical
  rcases hbase with
    ⟨baseStates, baseMachine, baseTime,
      hbaseTime, hbaseCorrect⟩
  let typedMachine :=
    finiteOverrideTypedMachine
      shortLanguage threshold baseMachine
  let machine := typedMachine.toMachine
  let time : Nat → Nat :=
    fun n => 2 * threshold + baseTime n
  refine
    ⟨Fintype.card (OverrideState threshold baseStates),
      machine, time,
      polynomiallyBounded_add_constant
        (2 * threshold) hbaseTime,
      ?_⟩
  intro input
  let totalLength := totalInputLength input
  let baseSteps := baseTime totalLength
  by_cases hshort :
      (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold
  · have htotal :
        (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length + 1 ≤
          2 * threshold + baseSteps := by
      omega
    letI :
        Decidable
          (input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage) :=
      Classical.propDecidable _
    have hresult :=
      finiteOverrideTypedMachine_result_short
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input
        hshort (2 * threshold + baseSteps) htotal
    constructor
    · rw [typedMachine.toMachine_acceptsWithin_iff]
      simpa [typedMachine, machine, time, baseSteps,
        totalLength, hshort] using
        (show
          typedMachine.result
              (typedMachine.run input
                (2 * threshold + baseSteps)).state =
                some true ↔
            input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage by
          rw [hresult]
          simp)
    · rw [typedMachine.toMachine_rejectsWithin_iff]
      simpa [typedMachine, machine, time, baseSteps,
        totalLength, hshort] using
        (show
          typedMachine.result
              (typedMachine.run input
                (2 * threshold + baseSteps)).state =
                some false ↔
            ¬input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage by
          rw [hresult]
          simp)
  · have hlong :
        threshold ≤
          (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length :=
      Nat.le_of_not_gt hshort
    have hrun :=
      finiteOverrideTypedMachine_run_long
        shortLanguage threshold baseMachine input
        hlong baseSteps
    have hbaseInput := hbaseCorrect input
    constructor
    · rw [typedMachine.toMachine_acceptsWithin_iff]
      change
        typedMachine.result
            (typedMachine.run input
              (2 * threshold + baseSteps)).state =
              some true ↔
          (if
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold
           then input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage
           else basePredicate input)
      rw [hrun]
      change
        baseMachine.result
            (baseMachine.run input baseSteps).state =
              some true ↔ _
      simpa [hshort, Machine.acceptsWithin,
        baseSteps, totalLength] using hbaseInput.1
    · rw [typedMachine.toMachine_rejectsWithin_iff]
      change
        typedMachine.result
            (typedMachine.run input
              (2 * threshold + baseSteps)).state =
              some false ↔
          ¬(if
            (input (firstTapeIndex tapes)).length < threshold
           then input (firstTapeIndex tapes) ∈ shortLanguage
           else basePredicate input)
      rw [hrun]
      change
        baseMachine.result
            (baseMachine.run input baseSteps).state =
              some false ↔ _
      simpa [hshort, Machine.rejectsWithin,
        baseSteps, totalLength] using hbaseInput.2

theorem DecidesInPolynomialTime.congr
    {tapes : Nat}
    {predicate₁ predicate₂ :
      (Fin tapes → List Bool) → Prop}
    (hdecides : DecidesInPolynomialTime predicate₁)
    (hequiv : ∀ input, predicate₁ input ↔ predicate₂ input) :
    DecidesInPolynomialTime predicate₂ := by
  rcases hdecides with
    ⟨states, machine, time, htime, hcorrect⟩
  refine ⟨states, machine, time, htime, ?_⟩
  intro input
  constructor
  · exact (hcorrect input).1.trans (hequiv input)
  · exact (hcorrect input).2.trans (not_congr (hequiv input))

end SipserGacsLautemann
theorems.natural_language_statement: A sorry-free generic machine construction that decides a fixed finite language on inputs shorter than a threshold and otherwise restores the initial tapes exactly before delegating to an arbitrary polynomial-time base machine. It includes the exact run simulation and polynomial time bound.
theorems.source: Reusable finite-exception closure construction for the custom Turing-machine model in the Sipser–Gács–Lautemann mission.
